a: Ushelamim "sham" "sham" mimmaaser. uminna: ma shelamim en gufan maaser – af toda name en gufah maaser, vehane chitte hallekuchot bimot maaser sheni name en gufan maaser.

Ema tama didi: toda mehecha ka yalefna la? mishshelamim, ushelamim – "sham" "sham" mimmaaser. ma shelamim en min maaser, af toda en min maaser, leappoke chittin hallekuchot bimot maaser sheni, demin maaser ninhu.
Amar rabbi amme: hammatpis meot maaser sheni lishlamim – lo kanu shelamim. may tama? dela allima kedushsha dishlamim lemechal akkedushshat maaser sheni.
Metivi: hallokeach chayya lezivche shelamim, uvehema livsar taava – lo yatza haor lechullin. lav lememra dekane shelamim?
Ha ittemar ala, amar rav: la kane shelamim, umay "lo yatza haor lechullin"? hachi kaamar: eno betorat latzet haor lechullin, may tama? amar rabba: naasa kelokeach shor lacharisha.
Ittemar, hammatpis meot maaser sheni lishlamim: rabbi yochanan amar: kane, rabbi elazar omer: la kane.

Veallibba derabbi yehuda, deamar: maaser mamon hedyot hu – dechulle alma la peligi dekane. ki peligi allibba derabbi meir, deamar: maaser mamon gavoah hu. man deamar la kane – kerabbi meir, uman deamar kane – kevan demaaser (kare) [karev] leh shelamim, ki maytpesat leh name tafes.
Metivi: hammatpis meot maaser sheni lishlamim, keshehu podan – mosif alehem shene chumeshin, echad lehekdesh veechad lemaaser.
Mi savrat divre hakkol hi? ha manni? rabbi yehuda hi.

Mishna minnayin laomer "hare alay toda", shello yavi ella min hachullin? talmud lomar "vezavachta pesach laAdonai elohecha tzon uvakar". vahalo pesach en ba ella min hakkevasim umin haizzim, im ken ma talmud lomar "tzon uvakar"? lehakkish kol habba min hatztzon umin habbakar lefesach: ma pesach davar shebbechova veen ba ella min hachullin, af kol davar shebbechova en ba ella min hachullin.
Lefichach, haomer "hare alay toda", "hare alay shelamim", hoil uvain chova – lo yavou ella min hachullin, unesachim bechol makom – lo yavou ella min hachullin.

Gemara ufesach gufeh mena lan? detanya: rabbi eliezer omer: neemar pesach bemitzrayim, veneemar pesach ledorot, ma pesach haamur bemitzrayim lo ba ella min hachullin, af pesach haamur ledorot lo ba ella min hachullin.
Amar lo rabbi akiva: vechi danin efshar mishshei efshar? amar lo: af al pi shei efshar, reayay gedola hi, venilmad hemenna.
Chazar rabbi akiva vedano din acher: ma lefesach mitzrayim, shekken en taun mattan damim veemurin legabbe mizbeach,
b: Tomar befesach dorot shettaun mattan damim veemurin legabbe mizbeach?
Amar lo: hare hu omer: "veavadta et haavoda hazzot bachodesh hazze", sheyyihyu kol avodot shel chodesh hazze kaze.
Verabbi akiva, i savar la deen danin efshar mishshei efshar – leku bemilleteh!
I hadar beh, vehay dela gamar mippesach mitzrayim mishshum hay pircha hu, pesach midbar yochiach!

Lidvarav derabbi eliezer kaamar: ledidi en danin efshar mishshei efshar, ledidach deamrat danin efshar mishshei efshar – ma lefesach mitzrayim shekken eno taun mattan damim veemurin legabbe mizbeach, tomar befesach dorot shettaun mattan damim veemurin legabbe mizbeach?
Vaamar leh rabbi eliezer: "veavadta".
Verabbi eliezer, lema leh: pesach midbar yochiach!
Lidvarav derabbi akiva kaamar leh, ledidi danin efshar mishshei efshar, umishshum hay pircha – pesach midbar yochiach, ledidach deamrat en danin efshar mishshei efshar – "veavadta".
Vehasheta name lifroch? amar rav sheshet: zot omeret, en meshivin al hahekkesh.
Uvetarbitza amur: vechi davar hallamed behekkesh chozer umelammed behekkesh? bichlala ittemar, pesach kulleh chada milleta hi.

Verabbi akiva, pesach deeno ba ella min hachullin mena leh? nafka leh meha deamar shemuel mishshum rabbi eliezer: "zot hattora laola velammincha velachattat velaasham velammilluim ulezevach hashshelamim".
"Ola" – ma ola teuna keli, af kol taun keli. may hi? ilema mizrak, gabbe zivche shalme tzibbur name ketiv "vayyasem baagganot".
Ella sakkin, veola gufa menalan? dichtiv: "vayyishlach avraham et yado vayyikkach et hammaachelet lishchot et beno", vehatam ola hu, dichtiv: "vayyaalehu leola tachat beno".
"Mincha" – ma mincha enah neechelet ella lezichre chehunna, af kol en neechalin ella lezichre chehunna. may? i chattat veasham –

a: Behedya ketiv!
I zivche shalme tzibbur – meribbuya dikrae ate: "bekodesh hakkodashim tochlennu kol zachar (bakkohanim) yochal oto", limmed al zivche shalme tzibbur sheen neechalim ella lezichre chehunna!
Tannae hi, ikka demayyte la mehacha, veikka demayyte la mehacha.
"Chattat" – ma chattat mekaddeshet bevillua, af kol mekaddesh bevillua.
"Asham" – ma asham en shafir veshilya kadosh bo, af kol en shafir veshilya kadosh bo. kasavar: valdot kadashim bahavayaytan hen kedoshim, vedanin efshar mishshei efshar.
"Milluim" – ma milluim motrehen bisrefa, veen baale chayyim motrehen bisrefa, af kol motrehen bisrefa, veen baale chayyim motrehen bisrefa.
"Shelamim" – ma shelamim mefaggelin umitpaggelin, af kol mefaggelin umitpaggelin.
Bematnita tana mishshemeh derabbi akiva: "zot hattora kulei mincha" – ma mincha mekaddeshet bevillua, af kol mekaddeshet bevillua.

Veitzterich lemichtav bechattat, veitzterich lemichtav bemincha. dei ketav rachamana bemincha – mishshum derakkicha bala, aval chattat ema la. vei ketav rachamana bechattat – mishshum devasar aggav deshammin (kadir) [karir], aval mincha ema la, tzericha.
"Chattat" – ma chattat enah baa ella min hachullin, uvayyom, uveyado hayemanit, af kol eno ba ella min hachullin, uvayyom, uveyado hayemanit.
Vechattat gufa menalan? amar rav chisda, deamar kera: "vehikriv aharon et par hachattat asher lo" – "lo" mishshello, velo mishshel maaser.
Bayyom – mibbeyom tzavvoto" nafka! kedi nasva.
Beyado hayemanit – midderabba bar bar chana nafka, deamar rabba bar bar chana amar resh lakish: kol makom shenneemar etzba uchehunna – eno ella yamin! kedi nasva.
"Asham" – ma asham atzmotav muttarin, af kol atzmotav muttarin.
Verabbi akiva, hay "vezavachta pesach"
b: May aved leh? mibbee leh lechidrav nachman, deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: minnayin lemotar happesach shekkarev shelamim? shenneemar: "vezavachta pesach laAdonai elohecha tzon uvakar", vahalo en pesach ba ella min hakkevasim umin haizzim! ella motar happesach yehe ledavar habba min hatztzon umin habbakar.
Veha mehacha nafka? middaavu dishmuel nafka, dichtiv: "im min hatztzon korbano lezevach shelamim", veamar avu dishmuel: davar habba min hatztzon yehe lezevach shelamim.
Veakkatti mehacha nafka? mehatam nafka! vehatanya: "keves" – lerabbot et happesach lealya.
Keshehu omer: "im keves" – lehavi pesach sheavra shenato, ushelamim habbaim mechamat pesach, lechol mitzvat shelamim: sheyyitanu semicha, unesachim, utenufat chaze vashok.
Keshehu omer "veim ez" – hifsik hainyan, limmed al haez sheenah teuna alya.
Telata kerae ketiv: chad leibbera zemanno veibbera shenato, vechad leibbera zemanno velo ibbera shenato, vechad lelo ibbera zemanno velo ibbera shenato.
Utzerichi, dei ashmeinan ibbera zemanno veibbera shenato, mishshum deiddechi leh ligmare, aval ibbera zemanno velo ibbera shenato, dachaze lefesach sheni, ema la.
Vei ashmeinan ibbera zemanno velo ibbera shenato, deiddechi leh mippesach rishon, aval lo ibbera zemanno velo ibbera shenato, daafillu lefesach rishon name chaze, ema la, tzericha.
Hadaran alach hattoda hayta baa.
Mishna kol korbenot hatztzibbur vehayyachid bain min haaretz umechutza laaretz, min hechadash umin hayyashan, chutz min haomer ushete hallechem, sheenan bain ella min hechadash umin haaretz.
Vechullan enan bain ella min hammuvechar, veezehu muvechar shellahem? (michnes vezatcha) [michmas vezonecha] – alpa lassolet, sheniyyay lahen – aforayim babbika.
Kol haaratzot hayu kesherot, ella mikkan hayu meviin.
Gemara matnitin dela ki hay tanna, detanya: omer habba min hayyashan – kasher, shete hallechem habbaot min hayyashan – kesherot, ella shechisser mitzva.
Omer – dichtiv "takriv et minchat bikkurecha", vaafillu min haaliyyay.
Shete hallechem – dichtiv: "mimmoshvotechem taviu", velo min chutza laaretz. "mimmoshvotechem" – vaafillu min haaliyyay.
Ha appekteh? amar kera "taviu", vaafillu min haaliyyay.
Vehay mibbee leh, shekkol sheatta mevi mimmakom acher – hare hu kaze! im ken, lichtov kera "tavi", may "taviu"? shema minna tarte.
Vehachtiv "reshit"? lemitzva.
Hachtiv "chadasha"? hay mibbee leh lechidtanya: rabbi natan verabbi akiva amru: shete hallechem habbaot min hayyashan – kesherot, uma ani mekayyem "chadasha"? shettehe chadasha lechol hammenachot.
Ad kan la peligi ella bechadash,

a: Aval baaretz la peligi, deomer ushete hallechem mearetz – in, mechutza laaretz – la.
Keman? dela ki hay tanna, detanya: rabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda omer: omer ba mechutza laaretz, uma ani mekayyem "ki tavou el haaretz"? shello nitchayyeyvu baomer kodem shennichnesu laaretz.
Vekasavar chadash bechutza laaretz deorayyta hi, dichtiv "mimmoshvotechem", kol makom sheattem yoshvin mashma, vechi "tavou" zeman bia hi, vechevan deorayyta hi – akrove name makrivin.
Tenan hatam: shomre sefichin bashsheviit, notlin secharan mitterumat hallishka.
Rame leh rame bar chama lerav chisda: tenan shomre sefichin bashsheviit notlin secharan mitterumat hallishka, ureminhu: "leochla" – velo lisrefa.
Amar leh: rachamana amar lach "ledorotechem", veat amrat tivtal?
Amar leh: umi kaamena ana tivtal?! layyte middeeshtakad! baena "karmel", velekka.
Velayyte mikkarmel deeshtakad? amar kera: "karmel takriv", baena karmel bishat hakerava, velekka.
Ittemar: rabbi yochanan amar "karmel takriv", rabbi elazar omer "reshit ketzircha" – reshit ketzircha, velo sof ketzircha.
Motev rabba: "veim takriv minchat bikkurim" – beminchat haomer hakkatuv medabber. mehechan hi baa? min hasseorim. atta omer min hasseorim, o eno ella min hachittin?
Rabbi eliezer omer: neemar "aviv" bemitzrayim, veneemar "aviv" ledorot. ma "aviv" haamur bemitzrayim – seorim, af "aviv" haamur ledorot – eno ba ella min hasseorim.

Rabbi akiva omer: matzinu yachid shemmevi chovato min hachittin, umevi chovato min hasseorin, veaf tzibbur mevi chovato min hachittin umevi chovato min hasseorin. im atta omer min hachittin – lo matzinu tzibbur shemmevi chovato min hasseorin!
Davar acher: im atta omer omer ba min hachittin – in shete hallechem "bikkurim". alma mishshum "bikkurim" hu, teyuveta.
Tenan hatam: en meviin bikkurim chutz mishshivat hamminin, velo
b: Mittemarim shebbeharim velo mipperot shebbaamakim. amar ulla: im hevi lo kiddesh.

Yatev rabba veka amar la leha shemata, etiveh rabbi acha bar abba lerabba: "korban reshit" – shettehe reshit lechol hammenachot, vechen hu omer: "behakerivchem mincha chadasha laAdonai beshavuotechem".
En li ella chadasha shel chittim, chadasha shel seorim minnayin? talmud lomar "chadasha", "chadasha". im eno inyan lachadasha shel chittin – tenehu inyan lachadasha shel seorim.

Uminnayin shettehe kodemet levikkurim? talmud lomar: "vechag shavuot taase lecha bikkure ketzir chittim", veen li ella bikkure ketzir chittim, ketzir seorim minnayin? talmud lomar: "vechag hakkatzir bikkure maasecha asher tizra bassade".
Veen li ella shettizra, alu mealehen minnayin? talmud lomar "bassade".
Veen li ella bassade, minnayin lerabbot shebbegag, veshebbechureba, veshebbeatzitz, veshebbisfina? talmud lomar "bikkure kol asher beartzam".

Minnayin shettehe kodemet linsachim uferot hailan? neemar kan "bikkure maasecha", veneemar lehallan "beospecha et maasecha min hassade" – ma lehallan nesachim uferot ilan, af kan nesachim uferot ilan.
Katane miha: shebbegag, shebbechureba, shebbeatzitz, veshebbisfina. sefa atan limnachot.
Matkef la rav adda bar ahava: i hachi, hayeynu dichtiv "kol tahor bevetcha yochal oto", vei menachot, lezichre chehunna hu demitachlan!
Amar rav mesharsheya: tere kerae ketivi, "lecha yihye", uchetiv "kol tahor bevetcha yochal oto". ha ketzad? kan – bevikkurim, kan – bimnachot.
Rav ashe amar: kulleh bimnachot, vesefa dikra atan lelachme toda.
Biflugeta: rabbi yochanan amar – im hevi lo kiddesh, resh lakish amar – im hevi kiddesh, naasa kechachush bekadashim.

Bishlama resh lakish, kidamar tama. ella rabbi yochanan, may tama? amar rabbi elazar: rabbi yochanan chazay bachalom, milleta meallayyta amena. amar kera: "mereshit" – velo kol reshit, "meartzecha" – velo kol artzecha.
Veresh lakish, hay "artzecha" may aved leh? mibbee leh lechidtanya: rabban gamliel bar rabbi omer, neemar kan "eretz", veneemar lehallan "eretz", ma lehallan shevach eretz, af kan shevach eretz.
Veiddach, "eretz" "meeretz".
Veiddach, "eretz" "mearetz" la mashma leh.
Tane chada: shebbegag, veshebbechureba, shebbeatzitz, veshebbisfina – mevi vekore. vetanya iddach: mevi veeno kore.
Bishlama resh lakish, gag aggag la kashya: ha – begag dimara, ha – begag devayit.
Chureba achureba – la kashya: kan bechureba avuda, kan bechureba sheenah avuda.
Atzitz aatzitz – la kashya: kan benakuv, kan besheeno nakuv.
Sefina assefina – la kashya, kan bisfina shel etz, kan bisfina shel cheres.

a: Ella lerabbi yochanan, kashya?
Tannae hi, detanya: shebbegag veshebbechureba – mevi vekore, shebbeatzitz veshebbisfina – eno mevi kol ikkar.
Vechullan enan baot ella min hammuvechar kulei. amri leh yochana umamre lemoshe: teven atta machnis leefrayim! amar lehu: amri inashe "lemata yarka – yarka shekol".
Mishna en meviin lo mibbet hazzevalim, velo mibbet hashshelachim, velo mibbet hailan, veim hevi – kasher.
Ketzad hu ose? narah shana rishona, uveshana sheniyya zorah kodem lappesach shivim yom, vehiv osa solet merubba.
Ketzad bodek haggizbar? machnis yado letochah. ala bah avak – pesula, ad sheyyenappenna.
Veim hitlia – pesula.
Gemara ketzad ose? narah shana rishona. ibbaya lehu: hechi kaamar? narah shana rishona usheniyya narah vezorah, o dilma narah shana rishona usheniyya zorah belo narah?

Ta shema, detanya: amar rabbi yose: af chitte karaziyyim uchefar achim, ilmale semuchot lirushalayim – hayu meviin mehen, lefi sheen meviin et haomer ella min hassadot hammuderamot vehamenonarot lechach, shebbahen chamma zorachat, umehen chamma shokaat.
Ketzad ose? narah shana rishona, usheniyya choresh veshone, vezorah kodem lappesach shivim yom, kede shettehe semucha lachamma, veosa kane zeret veshibbolet zirtayim.

Vekotzer umeammer, vedash, vezore, uvorer, vetochen, umerakked, umevi etzel gizbar, vegizbar machnis yado letochah. im alta bah avak – omer lo: "chazor venappe otah sheniyya". mishshum rabbi natan amru: gizbar sach yado shemen, umachnis letochah ad shemmaale kol avakah.
Katane mihat choresh veshone.
Uletamaych, matnitin la katane "shone",
b: Barayyta katane "shone".
Ha la kashya, kan baavuda, kan besheenah avuda.
May have ala? ta shema, detanya: nar chetzyah vezorea chetzyah, nar chetzyah vezorea chetzyah.
Amar rabbi yochanan: en meviin et haomer ella min hassadot hammuderamot shebbeeretz yisrael, shebbahen chamma zorachat, umehen chamma shokaat.

Tanya name hachi, abba shaul omer: omer haya ba mibbikat bet mikla, kevat shalosh sein hayta, vesade muderemet hayta, uvah chamma zorachat umimmenna chamma shokaat. nayr chetzyah vezorea chetzyah, nayr chetzyah vezorea chetzyah.
Rav chilkiyya bar tovi hava leh karna deara, nar chetzyah vezara chetzyah, nar chetzyah vezara chetzyah, vaavada al chad tere, umezabben lehu lechitte lismida.
Veim hitlia – pesula. tanu rabbanan: solet shehitlia rubbah – pesula, vechittin shehitliu rubban – pesulot. bae rabbi yirmeya: berov chitta, o berov sea? teku.
Bae rava: hikdishan, mahu sheyyilke alehen mishshum baal mum? kevan defasel – kevaal mum dame, o dilma en baal mum ella bivhema? teku.
Tenan hatam: kol etz shennimtza bo tolaat – pasul legabbe mizbeach. amar shemuel: lo shanu ella lach, aval yavesh – gorro vechasher.
Bae rava: hikdisho, mahu sheyyilke alav mishshum baal mum? kevan defasul kevaal mum dame, o dilma en baal mum ella bivhema? teku.
Mishna tekoa – alpa lashshemen. abba shaul omer: sheniyya lah regev beever hayyarden. kol haaratzot hayu kesherot, ella mikkan hayu meviin.

En meviin lo mibbet hazzevalim, velo mibbet hashshelachim, velo min ma shennizra benehem, veim hevi – kasher. en meviin anpaktan, veim hevi – kasher. en meviin min haggargerin shennishru bemayim, velo min hakkevashim, velo min hashshelukim, veim hevi – pasul.
Gemara "vayyishlach yoav tekoa vayyikkach mishsham ishsha chachama", may shena tekoa? amar rabbi yochanan: mittoch shergilin beshemen zayit, chachma metzuya bahen.

Tanu rabbanan: "vetovel beshemen raglo" – ze chelko shel asher, shemmoshech shemen kemayan. amru: paam achat nitzrechu lahen anshe ludekiyya (beshemen) [leshemen], minnu lahen pulemostus echad, amru lo: lech vehave lanu shemen bemea ribbo.

Halach lirushalayim, amru lo: lech letzor, halach letzor, amru lo: lech legush chalav, halach legush chalav, amru lo: lech etzel peloni lesade hallaz, umetzao shehaya ozek tachat zetav. amar lo: yesh lecha shemen bemea ribbo sheani tzarich? amar lo: hameten li ad sheasayyem melachti, himtin ad shessiyyem melachto.

Leachar shessiyyem melachto, hifshil kelav laachorav, vehaya mesakkel uva badderech. amar lo: yesh lecha shemen bemea ribbo? kimdumme ani shessechok sachaku bi hayyehudim. kevan shehiggia leiro, hotzia lo shifchato kumekmos shel chammin, verachatz bo yadav veraglav. hotzia lo sefel shel zahav melea shemen, vetaval bo yadav veraglav, lekayyem ma shenneemar: "vetovel bashshemen raglo".

Leachar sheachlu veshatu, madad lo shemen bemea ribbo. amar lo: kelum atta tzarich leyoter? amar lo: hen, ella sheen li damim. amar lo: im atta rotze likkach – kach, vaani elech immecha veettol damav. madad lo shemen bishmona asar ribbo. amru: lo hinniach oto haish lo sus velo pered velo gamal velo chamor beeretz yisrael shello secharo.

Kevan shehiggia leiro, yatzu anshe iro lekalleso. amar lahem: lo li kallesuni, ella laze shebba immi, shemmadad li shemen bemea ribbo, vahare noshe bi bishmone esre ribbo, lekayyem ma shenneemar: "yesh mitashsher veen kol mitroshesh vehon rav".
En meviin lo mibbet hazzevalim, vehatanya: en meviin anpaktan,

a: Veim hevi – pasul (vehatanya: veim hevi – kasher), mippene shehu seraf.
Amar rav yosef: la kashya, ha rabbi chiyyay, ha rabbi shimon bar rabbi, derabbi chiyyay zarek leh, verabbi shimon bar rabbi metabbel [beh] (leh), vesimanaych: ashirim mekammetzin.
"Shishsha chodashim beshemen hammor" – may "shemen hammor"? rav huna bar chiyyay amar: setachta. rabbi yirmeya bar abba amar: shemen zayit shello hevi shelish.
Tanya name hachi: rabbi yehuda omer: anpikinon – shemen zayit shello hevi shelish, lamma sachin oto? shemmashshir et hassear umeadden et habbasar.
En meviin min haggargerin shennishru bemayim. tanu rabbanan: shemen zayit kavush, shaluk, sharuy, veshel shemarim, veshel reach ra – lo yavi, veim hevi – pasul.
Bae rabba: hikdisho, mahu sheyyilke alav mishshum baal mum? kevan defasul – kevaal mum dame, o dilma en baal mum ella bivhema? teku.
Mishna shelosha zetim hen, uvahen shelosha shelosha shemanim.
Hazzayit harishon megargero berosh hazzayit, vechotesh venoten letoch hassal, rabbi yehuda omer: sevivot hassal – ze rishon.
Chazar vetoen bekora, rabbi yehuda omer: baavanim – ze sheni.
Chazar vetachan, vetaan – ze shelishi.
Harishon – lammenora, vehashshear – limnachot.
Hashsheni – megargero berosh haggag, vechotesh, venoten letoch hassal, rabbi yehuda omer: sevivot hassal – ze rishon.
Toen bekora, verabbi yehuda omer: baavanim – ze sheni.
Chazar vetachan, vetaan – ze shelishi.
Harishon – lammenora, vehashshear – limnachot.
Shelishi: otno bevet habbad, ad sheyyilke, umaalehu umenaggevo berosh haggag, kotesh venoten letoch hassal. rabbi yehuda omer: sevivot hassal – ze rishon.
Toen bekora, rabbi yehuda omer: baavanim – ze sheni.
Chazar vetachan vetaan – ze shelishi.
Harishon – lammenora, vehashshear – limnachot.
Gemara ibbaya lehu: megargero tenan, o megalgelo tenan?

Ta shema, detanya: "shemen zayit mizzeto" – mikkan amru: zayit rishon megalgelo berosh hazzayit, vechonso levet habbad, vetochano berechayim, venotno besallin. shemen hayyotze mimmennu, ze haya rishon.
Taan bekora, shemen hayyotze mimmennu – ze haya sheni, vechazar ufarak, tachan vetaan – ze haya shelishi. harishon lammenora, vehashshear limnachot. vechen zayit sheni.

Vezayit shelishi, otno bevet habbad ad sheyyilke, umaale lerosh haggag, veose oto kemin temara ad sheyyazuvu memav, vechonso levet habbad, vetochano barechayim, venotno besallin, vashemen hayyotze mimmennu – ze haya rishon.
Taan bekora, shemen hayyotze mimmennu – ze haya sheni. parak chazar vetachan vetaan – ze haya shelishi. harishon lammenora, vehashshear limnachot.
Rabbi yehuda omer: lo haya tochano barechayim, ella kotsho bemachteshet, velo haya toen bekora ella baavanim, velo haya notno besallin ella letoch sevivot hassal.
Ha gufa kashya: kotesh – manni? rabbi yehuda hi, toch hassal – atan lerabbanan!
Hay tanna savar la kevateh bachada, ufaleg aleh bachada.

Mishna harishon shebbarishon – en lemala hemennu. hashsheni shebbarishon veharishon shebbashsheni – shavin. hashshelishi shebbarishon vehashsheni shebbashsheni veharishon shebbashshelishi – shavin. hashshelishi shebbashsheni vehashsheni shebbashshelishi – shavin. hashshelishi shebbashshelishi – en lematta hemennu.

Af kol hammenachot hayu baddin sheyyitanu shemen zayit zach, ma menora sheenah laachila teuna shemen zayit zach, menachot shehen laachila eno din sheyyitanu shemen zayit zach! talmud lomar "zach katit lemaor", veen zach katit limnachot.
b: Gemara shavin? veha amrat rishon lammenora vehashshear limnachot! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: may shavin – shavin limnachot.
Af [kol] hammenachot hayu baddin [vechulei]. tanu rabbanan: "zach" – en "zach" ella naki, rabbi yehuda omer: "katit" – en "katit" ella katush.
Yachol yehe zach katit pasul limnachot? talmud lomar "veissaron solet balul beshemen katit", im ken ma talmud lomar "lammaor"? ella mippene hachissachon.
May "chissachon"? amar rabbi elazar: hattora chasa al mamonan shel yisrael.
"Tzav et bene yisrael veyikchu elecha shemen zayit zach", amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani: "elecha" – velo li, lo leora ani tzarich.
Shulchan batztzafon, umenora baddarom – amar rabbi zerika, amar rabbi elazar: lo laachila ani tzarich, velo leora ani tzarich.
Vayyaas labbayit challone shekufim atumim" – tana: shekufin mibbifnim, vaatumim mibbachutz, lo leora ani tzarich.
"Michutz lefarochet haedut beohel moed" – edut hu lechol bae olam shehashshechina shora beyisrael.
Veim tomar: leora ani tzarich? vahalo kol arbaim shana shehalchu yisrael bemidbar lo halchu ella leoro! ella edut hu lechol bae olam shehashshechina shora beyisrael.
May edutah? amar rava: ze ner maaravi, shennotnin bah shemen keneged chavroteha, umimmenna haya madlik, uvah haya mesayyem.
Mishna meayin hayu meviin et hayyayin? kedochayim vaatulayin – alpa layyayin, sheniyya lahen – bet rimma uvet lavan bahar, uchefar signa babbika. kol aratzot hayu kesherot, ella mikkan hayu meviin.

En meviin lo mibbet hazzevalim, velo mibbet hashshelachim, velo mimma shennizra benehen, veim hevi – kasher. en meviin hallisteyon, veim hevi – kasher. en meviin yashan – divre rabbi, vachachamim machshirin. en meviin lo matok, velo meushshan, velo mevushshal, veim hevi – pasul. veen meviin min haddaliyyot, ella min haragliyyot, umin hakkeramim haavudin.
Velo konsin oto bachatzavin gedolim, ella bechaviyyot ketannot, veeno memalle et hechavit ad piha, kede sheyyehe recho nodef.
Eno mevi mippiha – mippene

a: Hakkemachin, velo mishshuleha – mippene hashshemarim, ella mevi mishshelishah meemtzaah.
Ketzad hu bodek? haggizbar yoshev, vehakkane beyado, zarak haggir, hikkish bakkane.
Rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: sheyyesh bo kemachin – pasul, shenneemar: "temimim yihyu lachem", "uminchatam", "temimim yihyu lachem veniskehem".
Gemara en meviin lo matok velo mevushshal velo meushshan, veim hevi – pasul. veha katane resha: en meviin et helisteyon, veim hevi – kasher?
Amar ravina: keroch vetane. rav ashe amar: chuleya deshimsha – la meis, chuleya defera – meis.
En meviin yashan, divre rabbi, vachachamim machshirin. amar chizkiyya: may tama derabbi? amar kera "laכּveשׂ yayin", ma keves ben shenato, af yayin ben shenato.

I ma keves ben shete shanim – pasul, af yayin ben shete shanim – pasul! vechi tema hachi name, vehatanya: yayin ben shete shanim lo yavi, veim hevi – kasher! man shamat leh deamar "lo yavi"? rabbi, vekaamar: im hevi – kasher.
Ella amar rava: hayeynu tama derabbi, dichtiv "al tere yayin ki yitaddam".
En meviin lo min haddaliyyot kulei. tana: keramim haavudim paamayim bashshana.
Rav yosef hava leh karna defardesa, derafek beh tefe rifka, veaved chamra dedare mayya al chad teren.
Lo hayu konsin otan bachatzavin gedolim, tana: chaviyyot kaddiyyot ludiyyot uvenoniyyot.
En mannichin otan shetayim shetayim, ella achat achat.
Ketzad bodek gizbar? yoshev vekane beyado. zarak haggir – hikkish bakkane. tana: zarak haggir shel shemarim – gizbar hikkish bakkane.
Velema leh memar? mesayyay leh lerabbi yochanan, deamar rabbi yochanan: keshem shehaddibbur yafe labbesamim, kach dibbur ra layyayin.
Rabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda omer vechulei. bae rabbi yochanan: hikdisho, mahu sheyyilke alav mishshum baal mum? kevan defasul – kevaal mum dame, o dilma en baal mum ella bivhema? teku.
Tanu rabbanan: elim mimmoav, kevasim mechevron, agalim mishsharon, gozalot mehar hammelech.
Rabbi yehuda omer: meviin kevasim sheggovhan kerochban. amar rava bar rav shela: may tama derabbi yehuda? dichtiv: "yire miknecha bayyom hahu kar nirchav".

Ketiv: "al chomotayich yerushalim hifkadti shomrim kol hayyom vechol hallayla tamid lo yecheshu hammazkirim et Adonai al domi lachem". may amri? hachi amar rava bar rav shela: "atta takum terachem tziyyon".
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: "bone yerushalayim Adonai". umeikkara may havo amri? amar rava bar rav shela: "ki vachar Adonai betziyyon ivvah lemoshav lo".
Hadaran alach kol korbenot hatztzibbur.
Mishna shete middot shel yavesh hayu bemikdash, issaron vachatzi issaron. rabbi meir omer: issaron, issaron, vachatzi issaron.
Issaron, me haya meshammesh? shebbo haya moded lechol hammenachot, lo haya moded lo bishlosha lappar, velo beshel shenayim laayil, ella moddan esronot.
Chatzi issaron, ma haya meshammesh? shebbo haya moded chavitte kohen gadol, mechetza babboker umechetza ben haarbayim.
Gemara tanya: haya rabbi meir omer: ma talmud lomar "issaron issaron lakkeves haechad"? melammed sheshte esronot hayu bammikdash, echad gadush veechad machuk.
Gadush shebbo haya moded lechol hammenachot,
b: Machuk shebbo haya moded lachavitte kohen gadol.
Vachachamim omrim: lo haya sham ella issaron echad, shenneemar: "veissaron echad lakkeves haechad". im ken, ma talmud lomar "issaron issaron"? lerabbot chatzi issaron.
Verabbi meir, chatzi issaron mena leh? nafka leh mivveissaron". verabbanan, vav la darshi.
Verabbi meir, hay "veissaron echad lakkeves haechad" may aved leh? hahu shello yimdod lo beshel shelosha lappar, velo beshel shenayim laayil.

Verabbanan, nafka lehu minnekudde, detanya: amar rabbi yose: lamma nakud vav shebbeemtza "issaron" shel "issaron" rishon shel yom tov harishon shel chag? shello yimdod lo beshel shelosha lefar velo beshel shenayim laayil. verabbi meir nekudde la daresh.
Chatzi issaron, ma haya meshammesh? shebbo haya moded lachavitte kohen gadol.
Moded? ureminhi: chavitte kohen gadol lo hayu bain chatzain, ella mevi issaron shalem vechotzehu.
Amar rav sheshet: may "moded" name dekatane? mechallek.
Bea minneh rame bar chama merav chisda: chatzi issaron, lerabbi meir – gadush haya o machuk haya?
(Siman: chatzi, chavitte, shulchan).
Vetibbee lach lerabbanan? lerabbanan, issaron gufeh ka mibbaya lehu: gadush haya o machuk haya.
Amar leh: midderabbi meir nishma lerabbi meir, umidderabbi meir nishma lerabbanan.
Middeamar rabbi meir: issaron machuk, chatzi issaron name machuk; midderabbi meir machuk, lerabbanan name machuk.
Bea minneh rame bar chama merav chisda: chavitte kohen gadol bamme mechallekan lechallot, bayyad o bichli? peshita divyad, dei bichli – turetane yachnis?!
Veyachnis! kevan deviklala ketiv, lav orach ara.

Bea minneh rame bar chama merav chisda: shulchan mahu sheyyekaddesh kematzim begodesh shello? middimkaddesh lechem, kematzim name mekaddesh, o dilma dachaze leh mekaddesh, dela chaze leh la mekaddesh?

Amar leh: eno mekaddesh. ini? vehaamar rabbi yochanan: ledivre haomer tifchayim umechetza kofel, nimtza shulchan mekaddesh chamishsha asar tefach lemala. ledivre haomer tifchayim kofel, nimtza shulchan mekaddesh shenem asar tefach lemala.
Amar leh: eno mekaddesh likrav, aval mekaddesh lippasel.
Mishna sheva middot shel lach hayu bemikdash, hin, vachatzi hin, ushelishit hahin, ureviit hahin.
Log, vachatzi log, ureviit log.
Rabbi eliezer bar rabbi tzadok omer: shenatot hayu bahin, ad kan lappar, vead kan laayil, ad kan lakkeves.

Rabbi shimon omer: lo haya sham hin, vechi me haya hin meshammesh? ella midda yetera shel log umechetza hayta sham, shebbah haya moded leminchat kohen gadol – log umechetza babboker, log umechetza ben haarbayim.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: sheva middot shel lach hayu bammikdash – reviit log, vachatzi log, velog, ureviit hahin, ushelishit hahin, vachatzi hin, vehin, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer: hin, vachatzi hin, ushelishit hahin, ureviit hahin, velog, vachatzi log, ureviit log. rabbi shimon omer: lo haya sham hin, vechi ma haya hin meshammesh?

a: Et mi avi tachtav? ella midda yetera shel log umechetza hayta sham, shebbo haya moded lachavitte kohen gadol – log umechetza babboker, log umechetza ben haarbayim.
Amru lo: chatzi log hayta sham, veefshar leshaer bachatzi log.
Amar lahem: af ledivrechem, chatzi log velog lo yaase, reviit hayta sham, veefshar leshaer birviit! ella ze hakkelal haya bammikdash: keli shemmeshammesh midda zo eno meshammesh midda acheret.
Rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer: shenatot hayu bahin vechulei.
May ikka ben rabbi meir lerabbi yehuda? amar rabbi yochanan: berutze middot ikka benayyhu.
Leman deamar mimmatta lemala, kasavar berutze hammiddot nitkaddeshu, ureviit yahev leh rachamana lemoshe, veamar leh: shaar deka ayyli lehu berutzin.
Leman deamar mimmala lematta, kasavar berutze middot lo nitkaddeshu, vehin yahev leh rachamana lemoshe, veamar leh: shaar beha, deka nafki berutzin.
Abbaye amar: dechulle alma berutze hammiddot ikka lememar nitkaddeshu, veikka lememar lo nitkaddeshu, vehacha bimleim ka mippalgi.
Man deamar millemala lematta, ka savar meleim, shello yechasser veshello yotir.
Uman deamar mimmatta lemala, meleim – shello yechasser, aval yotir, "meleim" karena beh.
Amar mar: rabbi shimon omer lo haya sham hin, shappir kaamar lehu rabbi shimon lerabbanan! verabbanan – hava hin daavad moshe leshemen hammishcha, dichtiv "veshemen zayit hin".
Mar savar: kevan dildorot la hava tzerich, lefi shaa hu deavdeh veiggenez, veiddach: kevan dahava – hava.
Amar mar: veet mi avi tachtav. la saggi dela meayyel? kidamar ravina: gemiri shete semichot betzibbur, hacha name gemiri desheva middot shel lach hayu bemikdash.
Rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer: shenatot hayu bahin. velet leh sheva middot? let leh. vei baet ema: may "sheva middot"? sheva medidot.
Mishna reviit ma hayta meshammeshet? reviit mayim limtzora, ureviit shemen lenazir.
Chatzi log ma haya meshammesh? chatzi log mayim lesota, vachatzi log shemen letoda.
Uvallog haya moded lechol hammenachot.
Afillu mincha shel shishshim issaron, noten lah shishshim log. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: afillu mincha shel shishshim issaron en lah ella luggah, shenneemar "lemincha velog shamen".
Shishsha lappar, vearbaa laayil, ushelosha lakkeves.
Shelosha umechetza lammenora, chatzi log lechol ner.
Gemara yetev rabbi veka kashya leh: reviit lamma nimshecha? i metzora –
b: Chutz hu, vei nazir – lechem nazir bishchitat ayil hu dekadesh.
Amar leh rabbi chiyyay: shebbah haya moded lachavitte kohen gadol, reviit shemen lechol challa vechalla. kare aleh "meeretz merchak ish atzati".

Chatzi log, ma haya meshammesh? yetev rabbi veka kashya leh: chatzi log lamma nimshach? i sota – vechi chullin hu ditzrichi lekaddoshe? "mayim kedoshim" ketiv! i toda – lachme toda bishchitat toda hu dekadshi.
Amar leh rabbi shimon berabbi: shebbo haya mechallek chatzi log shemen lechol ner vaner. amar lo: ner yisrael, kach haya.
Amar rabbi yochanan amar rabbi: ner shekkavta, niddashshen hashshemen, niddashshena happetila. ketzad ose? metivah, venoten bah shemen, umadlikah.
Yatev rabbi zerika, veka mibbaya leh: keshehu noten bah shemen – kemidda rishona, o kemo shechasra?
Amar rabbi yirmeya: peshita dichmidda rishona, dei kema shechasra – mena yadinan may chisser? vechi tema dimshaar leh, im ken sheva middot (nafish) [nefishi] lehu middot tuva.
Kare aleh: "vahadarcha tzelach rechav al devar emet veanva tzedek".

Ittemar name, amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan, veamri la amar rabbi abba amar rabbi chanina amar rabbi: ner shekkavta, niddashshen hashshemen niddashshena happetila. ketzad ose? metivah, venoten bah shemen kemidda rishona, umadlikah.
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehuda, amar rav sheshet: ner shebbemikdash shel perakim hava.
Kasavar: ki ketiv "kikkar" umiksha" – ammenora veneroteha ketiv, kevan demibbaya hatava, i lav difrakim havay – la hava mittayyeyva leh.
Metivi: ketzad ose? mesallekan, umannichan beohel, umekannechan bisfog, venoten bahen shemen, umadlikan.
Hu deamar ki hay tanna, detanya: chachamim omrim: lo hayu mizzizin otah mimmekomah.
Mikkelal dei bae (leh) leozoza matze mezez la? ella ema: lo hayta zaza mimmekomah.

Uman chachamim? rabbi elazar hu, detanya: rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer: kemin tas shel zahav haya lah al gabbah, keshehu metivah – dochako kelappe piha, keshehu noten bah shemen – dochako kelappe roshah.

Uviflugeta dehane tannae, detanya: menora veneroteha baot min hakkikkar, veen malkacheha umachtoteha min hakkikkar. rabbi nechemya omer: menora hayta baa min hakkikkar, velo neroteha umalkacheha umachtoteha baot min hakkikkar.

Bemay ka mippalgi? behay kera, detanya: "kikkar zahav tahor yaase otah" – lamadnu lammenora shebbaa min hakkikkar, minnayin lerabbot neroteha? talmud lomar: "et kol hakkelim haelle". yachol sheani merabbe af malkacheha umachtoteha? talmud lomar: "otah", divre rabbi nechemya.
Kashya derabbi nechemya adderabbi nechemya, tere tannae veallibba derabbi nechemya.
Rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer: menora baa min hakkikkar, veen malkacheha umachtoteha veneroteha baa min hakkikkar. veella ma ani mekayyem et "kol hakkelim haelle" – shehayu kelim shel zahav.

Zahav behedya ketiv bo, "veasita et neroteha shiva veheela et neroteha veheir el ever paneha. umalkacheha umachtoteha zahav tahor". lo nitzrecha ella lefi nerot, salka datach amena: hoil ufi nerot ashchore mashchar, hattora chasa al mamonan shel yisrael,

a: Velebed zahav kol dehu, ka mashma lan.
Chatzi log shemen letoda.

Tanya: rabbi akiva omer: ma talmud lomar "bashshemen" "bashshemen" shene peamim? illu lo neemar ella "bashshemen" echad, hayiti omer: hare hu kechol hammenachot lelog. achshav shekkatav "bashshemen" "bashshemen", have ribbuy achar ribbuy, veen ribbuy achar ribbuy ella lemaet – miato hakkatuv lachatzi log.
Ribbuy achar ribbuy?! chad ribbuy hu.

Ella, illu lo neemar "bashshemen" kol ikkar, hayiti omer hare hu kechol hammenachot lelog. achshav shenneemar "bashshemen" "bashshemen", have ribbuy achar ribbuy, veen ribbuy achar ribbuy ella lemaet, miato hakkatuv lachatzi log.

Yachol yehe chatzi log ze mitchallek lishloshet minin, lachallot velarkikin velarvicha? keshehu omer "bashshemen" barvicha, sheen talmud lomar, ribba shemen larvicha. ha ketzad? mevi chatzi log shemen vechotzehu [chetzyo] lachallot velarkikin, vechetzyo larvicha.

Amar lo rabbi elazar ben azarya: akiva, im atta merabbe kol hayyom kullo "bashshemen" "bashshemen" – eni shomea lach, ella chatzi log shemen letoda, ureviit shemen lenazir, veachad asar yom shebben nidda lenidda – halacha lemoshe missinay.
Belog haya moded.
Tanu rabbanan: bimtzora ani ketiv "issaron ... balul ... velog", limmed al issaron shettaun log, divre chachamim.
Rabbi nechemya verabbi eliezer omrim: afillu mincha shel shishshim esronim en lah ella luggah, shenneemar: "lemincha velog shemen".
Verabbi nechemya verabbi eliezer ben yaakov, hay "issaron balul velog" may avdi leh? hahu legufeh, deka amar rachamana: layyte chad issaron.
Veiddach, legufeh la tzerich, middegalli rachamana gabbe metzora shelosha korbanot ushelosha esronot, hacha dechad korban – chad issaron.
Veiddach – itzterich, salka datach amena: hoil vechas rachamana aleh leetoye bedallut, ema la live (mane) [mincha] kelal. veiddach – ligmare la ashkechan.
Verabbanan, hay "lemincha velog shemen" may avdi leh? hahu lammitnaddev mincha, shello yifchot middavar hattaun log, umay nihu? issaron. veiddach, tarte shamat minna.
Shishsha lappar, arbaa laayil, shelosha lakkeves. menalan? dichtiv: "veniskehem chatzi hahin yihye lappar".
Hin – teresar lugge havayin, dichtiv: "shemen zayit hin", uchetiv: "shemen mishchat kodesh yihye ze li ledorotechem", ze begimatriyya teresar havayin.

Shelosha umechetza lammenora, chatzi log lechol ner. mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "meerev ad boker" – ten lah middatah shettehe doleket veholechet meerev ad boker. davar acher: "meerev ad boker" – en lecha avoda shekkeshera meerev ad boker ella zo bilvad. veshiaru chachamim chatzi log meureta vead tzafra.
Ikka deamri: millemala lematta shiaru, veikka deamri: mimmatta lemala shiaru.
Man deamar mimmatta lemala shiaru – hattora chasa al mamonan shel yisrael, uman deamar mimmala lematta shiaru – en aniyyut bimkom ashirut.
Mishna mearvin nische farim benische elim, nische chevasim benische chevasim, shel yachid beshel tzibbur,
b: Shel yom beshel emesh.
Aval en mearvin nische chevasim benische farim veelim, veim belalan ellu bifne atzman veellu bifne atzman venitarvu – kesherim, im ad shello balal – pasul.
Hakkeves habba im haomer, af al pi shemminchato kefula – lo hayu nesachav kefulim.
Gemara ureminhu:
"Vehiktiro", shello yearev chalavim bachalavim.
Amar rabbi yochanan: "im nitarvu" ka amar.

I hachi, veen mearvin nische chevasim benische farim veelim, vaafillu nitarvu name la? veha middekatane sefa: belalan ellu bifne atzman veellu bifne atzman venitarvu kesherin, mikkelal deresha lechattechilla ka amar!
Amar abbaye: hachi kaamar, mearvin yenan, im nitarev soltan veshamnan.
Veyenan lechitchilla la? vehatanya: bamme devarim amurim – besolet vashemen, aval yayin mearvin.

Ella amar abbaye: hachi kaamar – hecha dehuketar soltan veshamnan, mearvin yayin lechattechilla. hecha dela huketar – im nitarev soltan veshamnan, mearvin name yenan, veim lav – en mearvin, dilma ate leiarove solet veshemen lechattechilla.
Keves habba im haomer, tanu rabbanan: "uminchato shene esronim", limmed al keves habba im haomer shemminchato kefula.

Yachol keshem shemminchato kefula, kach yeno kaful? talmud lomar "venisko yayin reviit hahin". yachol lo yehe yeno kaful sheeno nivlal im minchato, aval yehe shamno kaful shennivlal im minchato? talmud lomar "venisko" – kol nesachav lo yehu ella reviit.
May talmuda? amar rabbi elazar: ketiv "veniskah", vekarenan "venisko".
Ketzad? "niskah" demincha kenisko" deyayin – ma yayin reviit, af shemen name reviit.
Amar rabbi yochanan: asham metzora sheshshechato shello lishmo, taun nesachim, sheim i atta omer ken – pesalto.
Matkef la rav menashsheya bar gadda: ella meatta, keves habba im haomer sheshshechato shello lishmo, tehe minchato kefula, sheim i atta omer ken – pesalto.

Vetamid shel shachar sheshshechato shello lishmo, yehe taun shene gezirin bechohen echad, sheim i atta omer ken – pesalto. vetamid shel ben haarbayim sheshshechato shello lishmo, yehe taun shene gezirin bishne chohanim, sheim i atta omer ken – pesalto.
In hachi name, ella amar abbaye: chada minnayyhu nekat.
Rabbi abba amar: bishlama hanach, olot ninhu,

a: I la chazu leolat chova korvi leolat nedava, ella hacha, i la mokmet leh bemilleteh – asham nedava mi ikka?
Tanya kevavteh derabbi yochanan: asham metzora sheshshechato shello lishmo, o shello natan middamo al gabbe behonot – hare zo ola legabbe mizbeach, vetaun nesachim, vetzarich asham acher lehattiro.
Mishna kol middot shebbammikdash hayu nigdashot, chutz mishshel kohen gadol, shehaya godshah letochah.
Middot hallach, berutzehen kodesh; umiddot hayyavesh, berutzehen chol.
Rabbi akiva omer: middot hallach kodesh, lefichach berutzehen kodesh. middot hayyavesh chol, lefichach berutzehen chol. rabbi yose omer: lo mishshum ze, ella shehallach neekar vehayyavesh eno neekar.
Gemara manni? i rabbi meir – chad gadush hava, i rabbanan – chad machuk hava.
Amar rav chisda: leolam rabbi meir, umay "kol middot"? kol medidot.
Middot hallach berutzehen kodesh, bemay ka mippalgi?
Tanna kamma savar: middat hallach nimshecha, ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz; middat yavesh nimshecha mibbifnim, velo nimshecha mibbachutz.
Verabbi akiva savar: middat hallach nimshecha ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz, middat yavesh lo nimshecha kol ikkar.
Verabbi yose savar: idde veidde nimshecha mibbifnim velo nimshecha mibbachutz, vehacha hayeynu tama – delach neekar umiggavvev demana ka ate, vehayyavesh eno neekar.
Vechi neekar may have? gavra lemay ditzrich ka mechavven.

Amar rav dimi bar shishna mishshemeh derav, zot omeret, kele sharet mekaddeshin shello middaat. ravina amar: leolam ema lach, kele sharet en mekaddeshin ella middaat, ugezera shemma yomru motziin mikkele sharet lechol.

Motev rabbi zera: sidder et hallechem veet habbazichin leachar hashshabbat, vehiktir et habbazichin bashshabbat – pesula. ketzad yaase? yannichennu lashshabbat habbaa, sheafillu hu al shulchan yamim rabbim – en bechach kelum.
Veammay? hatam name lema: gezera, shemma yomru: mafkidin bichle sharet!
Penim achutz ka ramet?! penim – lav kulle alma yadi, chutz – kulle alma yadi.
Tenan hatam: motar nesachim leketz hammizbeach.
May "motar nesachim"?
Rabbi chiyyay bar yosef amar: berutze middot. rabbi yochanan amar: keotah sheshshaninu: hamekabbel alav lesappek selatot mearba veamdu beshalosh – yesappek mearba,
b: Mishshalosh veamdu mearba – mesappek mearba, sheyyad hekdesh al haelyona.
Tanya kevavteh derabbi chiyyay bar yosef, tanya kevavteh derabbi yochanan.

Tanya kevavteh derabbi chiyyay bar yosef: berutze middot hallalu ma hayu osin bahen? im yesh zevach acher – yakrivu immo, veim lanu – yippaslu belina, veim lav – mekayyetzin bahen et hammizbeach, vekayitz ze mahu? olot – habbasar lashshem, veorot lakkohanim.

Tanya kevavteh derabbi yochanan: hamekabbel alav lesappek selatot mearba, veamdu mishshalosh – mesappek mearba. mishshalosh veamdu mearba – mesappek mearba, sheyyad hekdesh al haelyona. vezehu sheshshaninu: motar nesachim leketz hammizbeach.
Mishna kol korbenot hatztzibbur vehayyachid teunin nesachim, chutz min habbechor, vehammaaser, vehappesach, vehachattat, vehaasham. ella shechattato shel metzora vaashamo teunin nesachim.
Gemara tanu rabbanan:
"Vaasitem ishshe laAdonai" – yachol kol haole laishshim yehe taun nesachim, afillu mincha? talmud lomar "ola". shelamim minnayin? talmud lomar "zevach". toda minnayin? talmud lomar "o zevach".
Yachol sheani merabbe af bechor, umaaser, vafesach, vechattat, veasham? talmud lomar "lefalle neder o vindava" – ba beneder unedava taun nesachim, sheeno ba beneder unedava en taun nesachim.
Mashma lehotzi et ellu, otzi et chovot habbaot mechamat haregel baregel, umay ninhu? olot reiyyay veshalme chagiga. talmud lomar "o bemoadechem" – kol habba bemoadechem taun nesachim.
Mashma lehavi et ellu, avi seire chattat, hoil uvain chova baregel? talmud lomar "vechi taase ven bakar".
Ben bakar bakkelal haya, velamma yatza? lehakkish elav: ma ben bakar meyuchad ba beneder unedava, af kol ba beneder unedava.

"Laasot reach nichoach laAdonai min habbakar o min hatztzon", ma talmud lomar? lefi shenneemar "ola", shomea ani afillu olat haof bemashma, talmud lomar "min habbakar o min hatztzon", divre rabbi yoshiyya.

Rabbi yonatan omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer "zevach", veof eno zevach. im ken, ma talmud lomar "min habbakar o min hatztzon"? lefi shenneemar "adam ki yakriv mikkem korban laAdonai min habbehema min habbakar umin hatztzon", yachol haomer "hare alay ola" yavi mishshenehem? talmud lomar "min habbakar o min hatztzon" – ratza echad mevi, ratza shenayim mevi.
Verabbi yonatan, lema li kera? haamar: ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv "yachdav"!
Itzterich, salka datach amena:

a: Hoil uchetiv "umin hatztzon", keman dichtiv "yachdav" dame.
Ulerabbi yoshiyya, deamar: af al gav dela ketiv "yachdav" keman dichtiv "yachdav" dame, live kera!
Hachtiv: "im ola korbano min habbakar", "veim min hatztzon korbano".
Veiddach, itzterich – salka datach amena: hane mille bimfaresh, aval bistama – layyte mittarvayyhu! ka mashma lan.
Amar mar: toda minnayin? talmud lomar "o zevach". attu toda lav zevach hu? itzterich, salka datach amena: hoil veikka lechem bahada – la tive nesachim.
Umay shena meel nazir, deikka bahadeh lechem, uvae nesachim?
Salka datach amena: hatam shene minin, hacha arbaat minin – ka mashma lan.
Velichtov rachamana "lefalle neder o lindava", vela bae "ola"?

I la ketav rachamana "ola", hava amena: "vaasitem ishshe laAdonai" – kelal, "lefalle neder o lindava" – perat, "lereach nichoach" – chazar vechalal, kelal uferat uchelal, i atta dan ella keen happerat: ma happerat meforash davar sheeno ba al chet, af kol sheen ba al chet.
Otzi chattat veasham, shehen bain al chet, avi bechor umaaser vafesach, sheen bain al chet – talmud lomar "ola".
Hasheta dichtiv "ola", kelal uferat, ma merabbet beh? ma happerat meforash sheeno mechuyyayv veomed, af kol sheeno mechuyyayv veomed.
Lehavi valdot kodashim, utemuratan, veola habbaa min hammotarot.
Veasham shennittak liriyya, vechol hazzevachim shennizbechu shello lishman.

Vehasheta deamrat "o" lidrasha, lefalle neder o lindava, lema li? lechelkam. itzterich, salka datach amena: ad demayyte neder unedava la live nesachim, ka mashma lan deayyti neder lechodeh live nesachim, vei ayyti nedava lechodeh layyte nesachim.

Hanicha lerabbi yoshiyya, ella lerabbi yonatan lema li? salka datach amena: ayyti neder lechodeh – live nesachim, ayyti nedava lechodeh – live nesachim, ayyti neder unedava – tisge binsachim dechad, ka mashma lan.
"O bemoadechem" lema li? salka datach amena: hane mille deka mayyte ola beneder ushelamim bindava, i name ippecha.
Aval hecha deka mayyte ola ushelamim beneder, i name ola ushelamim bindava, shem neder echad veshem nedava achat hi, vetisge leh binsachim dechad, ka mashma lan "o bemoadechem".
"Vechi taase ven bakar ola o zavach", lema li? itzterich, salka datach amena: hane mille hecha deka mayyte ola ushelamim beneder, i name ola ushelamim bindava.

Aval hecha deka mayyte shete olot, chada beneder vachada bindava, i name shene shelamim, echad beneder veechad bindava, ema shem shelamim achat hi, shem ola achat hi, vetisge leh binsachim dechad, ka mashma lan.
"Lefalle neder o shelamim", lema li? salka datach amena: hane mille hecha demayyte shete olot, chada beneder vachada bindava, i name shene shelamim, chada beneder vachada bindava.

Aval hecha deka mayyte shete olot beneder, ushete olot bindava, i name shane shelamim beneder ushene shelamim bindava, shem ola echad hu veshem neder echad hu, vetisge leh binsachim dechad, ka mashma lan.
Verabbi yoshiyya, hay "min habbakar o min hatztzon" lema li?
Salka datach amena: hane mille [bitre mine, aval bechad mina – tisge leh binsachim dechad, ka mashma lan.
"Kacha taasu laechad", lema li? salka datach amena: hane mille] beze achar ze, aval bevat achat – tisge leh binsachim dechad; ka mashma lan.
Ella shechattato shel metzora vaashamo taun nesachim, mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "ushelosha esronim solet mincha" – bemincha habbaa im hazzevach hakkatuv medabber.
Atta omer bemincha habbaa im hazzevach, o eno ella bemincha habbaa bifne atzmah? keshehu omer "veheela hakkohen et haola veet hammincha", heve omer bemincha habbaa im hazzevach hakkatuv medabber.

Vaadayin eni yodea im teuna nesachim veim lav, talmud lomar "veyayin lannesech reviit hahin taase al haola o lazzavach lakkeves haechad", "ola" – zo olat metzora, "zavach" – zo chattat metzora, "o lazzavach" – zo asham metzora.
Vetippok leh tarvayyhu mizzavach",
b: Deamar mar: chattat veasham minnayin? talmud lomar "zavach".
Hane mille hecha detarvayyhu ki hadade ninhu, aval hecha deasham lehacheshir vechattat lechapper – baenan tere kerae.
"Zavach" – zo chattat metzora, veema zo chattat veasham denazir.
La salka datach, detanya: "uminchatam veniskehem" – beolato uvishlamav hakkatuv medabber.
Atta omer beolato uvishlamav, o eno ella afillu chattat? talmud lomar: "veet haayil yaase zevach shelamim uminchato venisko".
Ayil bakkelal haya, velamma yatza? lehakkish elav. ma ayil meyuchad ba beneder unedava, af kol ba beneder unedava.
"Ola" – zo olat metzora, veema zo olat yoledet?
Amar abbaye: olat yoledet missefa dikra nafka.
Detanya, rabbi natan omer: "lakkeves" – zo olat yoledet, "haechad" – ze achad asar shel maaser [shekkarev shelamim].
Shello matzinu lah bechol hattora, sheyyehe tafel chamur min haikkar.
Rava amar: ezehu davar shetztzarich shelosha ribbuyin? heve omer: zo metzora.
"Laayil", lema li? amar rav sheshet: lerabbot elo shel aharon.
Elo shel aharon, mibbemoadechem" nafka! salka datach amena: hane mille detzibbur, aval deyachid – la.
Umay shena meolat yoledet?
Salka datach amena: hane mille – davar sheen kavua lo zeman, aval davar shekkavua lo zeman – ema la. ka mashma lan.
"O laayil", lema li? lerabbot et happalgas.
Hanicha lerabbi yochanan, deamar birya hu, ditnan: hikrivu – mevi alav nische ayil, veeno ole lo mizzivcho, veamar rabbi yochanan: "o laayil" – lerabbot et happalgas.
Ella levar peda, deamar: mayyte umatne, disfeka hu, itzterich kera lerabboye sefeka?
Vadday levar peda kashya.

"Kacha yease lashshor haechad o laayil haechad o lasse vakkevasim o vaizzim". "leshor haechad" – ma talmud lomar? lefi shemmatzinu shechillek hakkatuv ben nische ayil lenische cheves, yachol nechallek ben nische far lenische egel – talmud lomar "lashshor haechad".

"O laayil" – ma talmud lomar? lefi shemmatzinu shechillek hakkatuv ben nische ben shana lenische ben shetayim, yachol nechallek ben nische ben shetayim lenische ben shalosh? talmud lomar "o laayil haechad".
"O lasse bakkevasim" – ma talmud lomar? lefi shemmatzinu shechillek hakkatuv ben nische cheves lenische ayil, yachol nechallek ben nische chivsa lenische rechela? talmud lomar "o lasse bakkevasim".
"O vaizzim" – ma talmud lomar? lefi shemmatzinu shechillek hakkatuv ben nische cheves lenische ayil, yachol nechallek ben nische gedi lenische sair – talmud lomar "o vaizzim".
Amar rav pappa: badek lan rava,

a: Nische rechela bechamma? ufashtina leh mimmatnitin: gedi meshammesh nische tzon shel gedolim veshel ketannim, shel zecharim veshel nekevot, chutz mishshel elim.
Mishna kol korbenot hatztzibbur en bahen semicha, chutz min happar habba al kol hammitzvot, vesair hammishtalleach. rabbi shimon omer: af sair avoda zara.
Kol korbenot hayyachid teunin semicha, chutz min habbechor vehammaaser vehappesach.
Vehayyoresh somech, umevi nesachim, umemer.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: kol korbenot hatztzibbur en bahen semicha, chutz mippar habba al kol hammitzvot useire avoda zara, divre rabbi shimon. rabbi yehuda omer: seire avoda zara en bahen semicha, veet mi avi tachtehem – sair hammishtalleach.
La saggi dela meayyel? amar ravina: gemiri shete semichot betzibbur.
Amar lo rabbi shimon: vahalo en semicha ella bivalim, veze – aharon uvanav somchin bo! amar lo: af ze – aharon uvanav mitkapperin bo.
Amar rabbi yirmeya: veazdu letamayyhu.

Detanya: "vechipper et mikdash hakkodesh" – ze lifnay velifnim, "veet ohel moed" – ze hechol, "mizbeach" – kemashmao, "yechapper" – ellu haazarot, "kohanim" – kemashmaan, "al kol am hakkahal" – ellu yisrael, "yechapper" – ellu haleviyyim.
Hushevu kullan lechappara achat, shemmitkapperin besair hammishtalleach, divre rabbi yehuda.

Rabbi shimon omer: keshem sheddam sair hannaase bifnim mechapper al yisrael al tumeat mikdash vekadashav – kach dam happar mechapper al hakkohanim al tumeat mikdash vekadashav. keshem shevvidduy shel sair hammishtalleach mechapper al yisrael bishar averot – kach vidduy shel par mechapper al hakkohanim bishar averot.
Verabbi shimon, ha vadday hushevu? in, hushevu divne kappara ninhu, mihu kol chad vechad mechapper bidnafsheh.

Lerabbi yehuda – tumeat mikdash vekadashav, yisrael mechapperi bedam sair hannaase bifnim, vechohanim befar shel aharon. bishar averot, ellu vaellu mechapperi bevidduy sair hammishtalleach. ulerabbi shimon – bishar averot name, kohanim bevidduy defar mitkapperi.

Kidkatane: echad yisrael veechad kohanim veechad kohen mashiach, ma ben yisrael lechohanim ulechohen mashiach? ella sheddam happar mechapper al hakkohanim al tumeat mikdash vekadashav, zo divre rabbi yehuda.

Verabbi shimon omer: keshem sheddam hassair hannaase bifnim mechapper al yisrael – kach dam happar mechapper al hakkohanim. keshem shevvidduyo shel sair hammishtalleach mechapper al yisrael – kach vidduyo shel par mechapper al hakkohanim.
Tanu rabbanan: "vesamchu zikne haeda et yedehem al rosh happar" – par taun semicha, veen seire avoda zara teunin semicha, divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi shimon omer: par taun semicha bizkenim, veen seire avoda zara taun semicha bizkenim, ella beaharon.
Ureminhu: "hachay" – hachay taun semicha, veen seire avoda zara teunin semicha, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer: chay" taun semicha beaharon,
b: Veen seire avoda zara teunin semicha beaharon, ella bizkenim.
Amar rav sheshet: vetisbera dehach kammayyta metaratzta hi? ha amar rabbi shimon: semicha bivalim baenan!

Ella taretz hachi: "happar" – par taun semicha, veen seire avoda zara teunin semicha, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer: "hachay" – chay taun semicha beaharon, veen seire avoda zara teunin semicha beaharon, ella bizkenim.
Vehachi ka amar leh rabbi shimon lerabbi yehuda: seire avoda zara bau semicha, vei shemia lach dela bau semicha – beaharon hu dishmia lach, umiuta mehachay" hu.
Verabbi yehuda, lema li lemaotinhu mikkera? veha amar ravina: gemiri shete semichot betzibbur, girsa bealma.
Verabbi shimon, seire avoda zara devaaya semicha – menalan?

Nafka lan middetanya: "vesamach yado al rosh hassair" – lerabbot seir nachshon lismicha, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer: lerabbot seire avoda zara lismicha, shehaya rabbi shimon omer: kol chattat shennichnas damah lifnim teuna semicha.
Lema li lememra "shehaya"? simana bealma.
Veema: sair hannaase bifnim! dumeya disir nasi, dimchapper al averot mitzva yedua.
Uleravina deamar: gemiri shete semichot betzibbur, kerae lema li?
Itzterich hilcheta, veitzterich keray.
Dei mikkera, hava amena: zivche shalme tzibbur.
Ki kushya ammatnitin dehach pirka, dechol hammenachot baot", amar rabbi shimon: shelosha minin teunin shalosh mitzvot.
Lete bekal vachomer, vihu zivche shalme tzibbur teunin semicha mikkal vechomer: ma shalme yachid, sheen teunin tenufa chayyim, teunin semicha chayyim vechulei. itzterich hilcheta.
Vei mehilcheta, hava amena la yadinan he ninhu, kamashma lan dumeya disir nasi, dimchapper al averot mitzva yedua.
Kol korbenot hayyachid teunin semicha, chutz mibbechor umaaser ufesach.

Tanu rabbanan: "korbano" – velo habbechor, sheyyachol vahalo din hu: uma shelamim sheen kedushshatan merechem teunin semicha, bechor shekkedushshato merechem eno din shettaun semicha! talmud lomar: "korbano" – velo habbechor.

"Korbano" – velo maaser, sheyyachol vahalo din hu: uma shelamim sheen mekaddeshin lifnehem uleacharehem teunin semicha, maaser shemmekaddesh lefanav uleacharav – eno din shettaun semicha! talmud lomar: "korbano" – velo maaser.
"Korbano" – velo pesach, sheyyachol vahalo din hu: uma shelamim sheeno baamod vehave" teunin semicha, pesach shehu baamod vehave" eno din shettaun semicha! talmud lomar: "korbano" – velo pesach.
Ikka lemifrach: ma lishlamim shekken teunin nesachim utenufat chaze vashok? kerae asmachta bealma.
Ella

a: Kerae lema li? "korbano" – velo korban chavero, "korbano" – velo korban goy, "korbano" – lerabbot kol baale korban lismicha.
Hayyoresh somech.
Tane rav chananya kammeh derava: yoresh eno somech, yoresh eno memer. veha anan tenan: hayyoresh somech, umevi et nesachav, umemer.
Amar leh efchay? amar leh: la, matnitin manni? rabbi yehuda hi, detanya: yoresh somech, yoresh memer. rabbi yehuda omer: yoresh eno somech, yoresh eno memer.
May tama derabbi yehuda? "korbano" – velo korban aviv, veyalef techillat hekdesh missof hekdesh: ma sof hekdesh – yoresh eno somech, af techillat hekdesh – yoresh eno memer.
Verabbanan: "hamer yamir" – lerabbot et hayyoresh, veyalef sof hekdesh mittechillat hekdesh: ma techillat hekdesh – yoresh memer, af sof hekdesh – yoresh somech.
Verabbanan, hay "korbano" may avdi leh? "korbano" – velo korban goy, "korbano" – velo korban chavero, "korbano" – lerabbot kol baale korban lismicha.

Verabbi yehuda, lerabbot kol baale korban lismicha – let leh, vei name it leh – goy vachavero mechad kera nafka. iyyaytaru leh tere kerae: chad – "korbano" velo korban aviv, veiddach – lerabbot kol baale korban lismicha.

Verabbi yehuda, hay "hamer yamir" may aved leh? mibbee leh lerabbot et haishsha, detanya: lefi shekkol hainyan kullo eno medabber ella bilshon zachar, ma sofenu lerabbot et haishsha? talmud lomar "hamer yamir".
Verabbanan darshi mivveim", verabbi yehuda "veim" la daresh.
Mishna hakkol somchin, chutz mecheresh, shote, vekatan, vesome, vegoy, vehaeved, vehashshaliach, vehaishsha.
Usemicha – sheyare mitzva.
Al harosh bishte yadayim, uvimkom shessomchin shochatin, vetechef lismicha shechita.
Gemara bishlama cheresh shote vekatan, delav bene dea ninhu. goy name – "bene yisrael" somchin veen goyim somchin. ella some may tama la?
Rav chisda verav yitzchak bar avdimi, chad amar: atya semicha semicha mizzikne eda".
Vechad amar: atya semicha semicha meolat reiyyay.
Uleman deamar meolat reiyyay, may tama la yalef min zikne eda?
b: Danin yachid miyyachid, veen danin yachid mitztzibbur.
Uleman deyalef mizzikne eda, may tama la yalef meolat reiyyay? danin midde dichtiv beh semicha begufeh, mimmidde dichtiv beh semicha begufeh, leappoke olat reiyyay, dehi gufa meolat nedava gamra.
Detane tanna kammeh derav yitzchak bar abba: "vayyakrev et haola vayyaaseha kammishpat" – kemishpat olat nedava, limmed al olat chova shetteuna semicha.
Vehaeved vehashshaliach vehaishsha. tanu rabbanan: "yado" – velo yad avdo, "yado" – velo yad shelucho, "yado" – velo yad ishto.
Kol hane lema li? tzericha, i ketav rachamana chad, hava amena lemaote eved, delav bar mitzvot, aval shaliach devar mitzva hu, ushelucho shel adam kemoto, ema lismoch.
Vei ashmeinan hane tarte, delav kegufeh damya, aval ishto dichgufeh damya, ema tismoch – tzericha.

Semicha sheyare mitzva. tanu rabbanan: "vesamach" "venirtza", vechi semicha mechapperet? vahalo en kappara ella baddam, shenneemar: "ki haddam hu bannefesh yechapper"! ella lomar lach, sheim asaah lismicha sheyare mitzva, maale alav hakkatuv keillu lo kipper, vechipper.

Vetanya gabbe tenufa ki hay gavvna: "litnufa lechapper", vechi tenufa mechapperet? vahalo en kappara ella baddam, shenneemar: "ki haddam hu bannefesh yechapper"! ella lomar lach, sheim asaah litnufa sheyare mitzva, maale alav hakkatuv keillu lo kipper, vechipper.
Al harosh, tanu rabbanan: "yado al harosh" – velo yado al hatztzavvar, "yado al harosh" – velo yado al haggabbayim, "yado al harosh" – velo yado al hechaze.
Kol hane lema li? tzerichi, dei ketav rachamana chad lemaote tzavvar, dela kae bahade rosho, aval gabbo dekae lahade rosho ema la, tzericha.
Vei ashmeinan hane tere, mishshum dela itrabbi litnufa, aval chaze deitrabbi litnufa, ema la, tzericha.
Ibbaya lehu: yado al hatztzedadin, mahu? ta shema, detanya: abba biraa berabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: "yado al rosho", vela yado al hatztzedadin.
Bae rabbi yirmeya: matlet mahu shettachotz? ta shema: uvilvad shello yehe davar chotzetz beno leven hazzevach.

Uvishte yadayim, mena hane mille? amar resh lakish, deamar kera "vesamach aharon et shete yadav", ketiv "yado" uchetiv "shete", ze bana av: kol makom shenneemar "yado" – hare kan shetayim, ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv "achat".

Azal rabbi elazar, amra leha shemata beve midresha, vela amra mishshemeh deresh lakish. shema resh lakish veikkefad, amar leh: i salka datach kol hecha dichtiv "yado" tarte ninhu, lema li lemichtav "yadav" "yadav"?
Akshi leh esrim vearba "yadav", "yadav teviena", "yadav rav lo", "sikkel et yadav" – ishtik.
Levatar denach dateh, amar leh: may tama la tema li, "yadav" dismicha kaamri?
Bismicha name ketiv: "vayyismoch et yadav alav vaytzavvehu", semicha divhema kaamri.
Uvimkom shessomchin shochatin, techef lismicha shechita. may kaamar? hachi kaamar: bimkom shessomchin shochatin, shettechef lismicha shechita.

Mishna chomer bassemicha mibbattenufa, uvattenufa mibbassemicha – sheechad menif lechol hachaverim, veen echad somech lechol hachaverim. chomer battenufa – shehattenufa noheget bekorbenot hayyachid uvekorbenot hatztzibbur,

a: Bechayyim uvishchutin, uvedavar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim uvedavar sheen bo ruach chayyim, ma sheen ken bassemicha.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: korbano – lerabbot kol baale korban lismicha.

Sheyyachol, vahalo din hu: uma tenufa shennitrabbeta bishchutin nitmaata bechovrin, semicha shello nitrabbeta bishchutin – eno din shettitmaet bechovrin? talmud lomar "korbano", lerabbot kol baale korban lismicha.
Vetitrabbe tenufa bechovrin mikkal vachomer: uma semicha shello nitrabbeta bishchutin, nitrabbeta bechovrin, tenufa shennitrabbeta bishchutin – eno din shennitrabbeta bechovrin!
Mishshum dela efshar, hechi lebed? laynpu kullehu bahade hadade – ka havya chatzitza, laynef velehdar velaynef – "tenufa" amar rachamana, velo tenufot.

Usemicha bishchutin leta? vehatnan: bizman shekkohen gadol rotze lehaketir, haya ole bakkevesh, vehassegan bimino. higgia lemachatzit hakkevesh – achaz segan bimino veheelahu, vehoshit lo harishon harosh veharegel, somech alehem vezorkan.
Hoshit hashsheni larishon shete yadayim, notno lechohen gadol, somech alehem vezorkan. nishmat hashsheni vehalach lo, vechach hayu moshitin lo shear kol haevarim, somech alehem vezorkan.
Uvizman shehu rotze – hu somech, vaacherim zorkin.
Amar abbaye: hatam mishshum kevodo dechohen gadol.
Hadaran alach shete middot.

Mishna shete hallechem nilloshot achat achat, veneefot achat achat. lechem happanim nilloshot achat achat, veneefot shetayim shetayim. uvidfus haya ose otan; keshehu rodan, notnan lidfus kede shello yitkalkelu.
Gemara mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "shene esronim yihye hachalla haechat" – melammed shennilloshot achat achat.
Minnayin sheaf shete hallechem kach? talmud lomar "yihye". uminnayin sheafiyyaytan shetayim shetayim? talmud lomar "vesamta otam". yachol af shete hallechem ken? talmud lomar "otam".
Hay "otam", ha appekteh? im ken, lema kera "vesamtam"! may "vesamta otam"? shamat minna tarte.

Tanu rabbanan: "vesamta otam" – bidfus. shelosha defusin hem: notnah lidfus vaadayin hi batzek, uchemin defus haya lah battannur, ucheshehu rodah notnah baddefus kede shello titkalkel. velahdera lidfus kamma? kevan deafe la, nafcha.
Ittemar: lechem happanim, ketzad osin oto?
b: Rabbi chanina amar: kemin teva perutza. rabbi yochanan amar: kemin sefina rokedet.
Bishlama leman deamar kemin teva perutza – hayeynu dahavo yatvi bazichin, ella leman deamar kemin sefina rokedet – hechi havo yatvi bazichin? makom aved lehu.
Bishlama leman deamar kemin teva perutza – hayeynu dahavo yatvi kanim, ella leman deamar kemin sefina rokedet – kanim hechi havo yatvi? muresha aved lehu.
Bishlama leman deamar kemin teva perutza – hayeynu desamchi leh senifin lelechem, ella leman deamar kemin sefina rokedet – hechi semachi leh senifin lelechem? deagil lehu migal.
Bishlama leman deamar kemin sefina rokedet – hayeynu devaenan senifin, ella leman deamar kemin teva perutza – senifin lema li? aggav yukera delechem talach.

Bishlama leman deamar kemin sefina rokedet – senifin al gabbe shulchan munnachin. ella leman deamar kemin teva perutza – senifin hecha mannach lehu? aara mannach lehu? in, deamar rabbi abba bar memel: ledivre haomer kemin sefina rokedet – senifin al gabbe shulchan munnachin, ledivre haomer kemin teva perutza – senifin al gabbe karka munnachin.
Keman azla ha deamar rabbi yehuda: hallechem maamid et hassenifin, vehassenifin maamidin et hallechem? keman deamar kemin sefina rokedet.

a: Metivi: kemin kavvevret haya lah battannur, vedoma kemin tavla merubbaat! ema: ufiha dome kemin tavla merubbaat.
Tanya keman deamar kemin sefina rokedet, detanya: arbaa senifin shel zahav hayu sham, mefutztzalin merashehen kemin dukranin hayu, shessomchin bahen et hallechem, shehu dome kemin sefina rokedet.
Ibbaya lehu: lechem happanim nifsal bammassaot, o eno nifsal bammassaot? rabbi yochanan verabbi yehoshua ben levi – chad amar: nifsal, vechad amar: eno nifsal.
Man deamar nifsal, dichtiv: "kaasher yachanu ken yissau". ma bachaniyyayto – nifsal beyotze, af binsiato – nifsal beyotze.
Man deamar eno nifsal, dichtiv: "velechem hattamid alav yihye".
Veiddach name, ha ketiv "kaasher yachanu ken yissau", leiddach gisa: ma bachaniyyayto, ki lo yatza mimmekomo – la mippesel, af binsiato, ki lo yatza mimmekomo – la mippesel.
Veiddach name, ha ketiv "velechem hattamid alav yihye"? ella, ki ata rav dimi amar: bimsuddar – dechulle alma la peligi, ella ki peligi – bimsullak.
Man deamar nifsal, dichtiv: "kaasher yachanu ken yissau", ma bachaniyyayto nifsal beyotze, af binsiato mippesel beyotze.
Leman deamar eno nifsal, dichtiv: "venasa ohel moed", af al pi shennasa, ohel moed hu.
Veiddach name, hachtiv "kaasher yachanu ken yissau", leiddach gisa: ma bachaniyyayto – ki la mappek leh la mippesel, af binsiato – ki la mappek leh la mippesel.
Veiddach name, ha ketiv "venasa ohel moed"? hahu lidgalim hu daata.
Veiddach, mimmachane haleviyyim betoch hammachanot" nafka.
Metivi: bishat silluk massaot, kadashim nifsalin beyotze, vezavin umetzorain mishtallechin chutz limchitzatan. may lav afillu lechem happanim? la, bar millechem happanim.
Ma nafshach, i "ohel moed" davka hu – afillu kodashim name, i "ohel moed" lav davka hu – afillu lechem happanim name.
Ella, ki ata ravin amar: mar amar bimsuddar, umar amar bimsullak, vela peligi.
Amar abbaye: shema minna yesh silluk massaot ballayla, dei salka datach en silluk massaot ballayla – emat middele? letzafra? may irya mishshum yotze? tippok li deippesil leh belina!
Peshita, "lalechet yomam valayla" ketiv! mahu detema: hane mille hecha daakur bimama, aval hecha dela akur bimama – belelya la matzu akri; ka mashma lan.
Ureminhi: hugellu happarochot, hutteru (hazzavin) [zavin] umetzorain likkanes lesham. amar rav ashe: la kashya, ha – rabbi eliezer, ha – rabbanan. detanya:
b: Rabbi eliezer omer: yachol dachaku zavin umetzorain venichnesu laazara befesach habba betumea yachol yehu chayyayvin? talmud lomar: "vishallechu min hammachane kol tzarua vechol zav vechol tame lanafesh", beshaa shettemee metim mishtallechin – zavin umetzorain mishtallechin.
En temee metim mishtallechin – en zavin umetzorain mishtallechin.

Mishna achat shete hallechem, veachat lechem happanim – lishatan vaarichatan bachutz, vaafiyyaytan bifnim, veenan dochot et hashshabbat. rabbi yehuda omer: kol maasehem bifnim. rabbi shimon omer: leolam heve ragil lomar shete hallechem velechem happanim kesherot baazara, uchesherot bevet page.
Gemara ha gufa kashya:

Amarta: lishatan vaarichatan bachutz – alma middat yavesh lo nitkaddesha, vaafiyyaytan bifnim – alma middat yavesh nitkaddesha! amar rabba: hiksha adam kashe, shehu kashe kabbarzel, umannu – rav sheshet.
May kashya? dilma issaron la mekaddesh, tannur mekaddesh.
Ella, i kashya – ha kashya: vaafiyyaytan bifnim, alma tannur mekaddesh, veen dochot et hashshabbat – ippasla belina! ella amar rava: hiksha adam kashe, shehu kashe kabbarzel, umannu – rav sheshet.
Amar rav ashe: may kusheya? dilma may "mibbifnim" – bimkom zerizin.

Veha derav ashe beruta hi, ma nafshach? i afiyyay baenan zerizin – lisha vaaricha name [baenan] zerizin, vei lisha [vaaricha] la baenan zerizin – afiyyay name la baenan zerizin, ella derav ashe beruta hi.
Rabbi yehuda omer: kol maasehen bifnim [vechulei]. amar rabbi avahu bar kahana: ushenehen mikra echad darshu, "vehu derech chol af ki hayyom yikdash bakkeli".
Rabbi yehuda savar: bachol ashkechinhu deka afu leh, amar lehu: derech chol ka afetu leh? "af ki hayyom yikdash bakkeli", ippesil leh belina.
Rabbi shimon savar: beshabbat ashkechinhu deka afu leh, amar lehu: la derech chol baetu lemibedeh?! midde tannur mekaddesh?! shulchan hu dimkaddesh.
Umi matzet amrat devishat afiyyay ashkechinhu? vehachtiv: "vayyitten lo hakkohen kodesh ki lo haya sham lechem ki im lechem happanim hammusarim millifne Adonai"!
Ella may "derech chol", deka amar lehu? – hachi ka amru leh: lekka lechem, ki im "lechem happanim hammusarim millifne Adonai".
Amar lehu: la mibbaya hay, dechevan dinfak leh mimmeila derech chol hu, ella afillu haych name dehayyom yikdash bakkeli" – havu leh delechol,

a: Mesukkan hu. verabbi yehuda verabbi shimon bigmara peligi.
Dayka name, dekatane: rabbi shimon omer: leolam heve ragil lomar shete hallechem velechem happanim kesherot baazara uchesherot abbet page, shema minna.

Mishna chavitte kohen gadol – lishatan vaarichatan vaafiyyaytan bifnim, vedochot et hashshabbat. techinatan veharekadatan enan dochot et hashshabbat. kelal amar rabbi akiva: kol melacha sheefshar laasotah meerev shabbat – enah docha et hashshabbat, veshei efshar lah laasotah meerev shabbat – docha et hashshabbat.
Kol hammenachot – yesh bahen maase cheli bifnim, veen bahen maase cheli bachutz.
Shete hallechem – orkah shiva tefachim, verochbah arbaa tefachim, vekarnoteha arba etzbaot. lechem happanim – orko asara tefachim, verochbo chamishsha tefachim, vekarnotav sheva etzbaot.
Rabbi yehuda omer: shello tite – 15, 22. ben zoma omer: "venatatta al hashshulchan lechem panim lefanay tamid" – "lechem panim" sheyyehu lo panim.
Hashshulechan – orko asara, verochbo chamishsha; lechem happanim – orko asara, verochbo chamishsha.
Noten orko keneged rochbo shel shulechan, vechofel tifchayim umechetza mikkan vetifchayim umechetza mikkan, nimtza orko memalle rochbo shel shulechan, divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi meir omer: hashshulchan – orko shenem asar, verochbo shishsha; lechem happanim – orko asara, verochbo chamishsha.
Noten orko keneged rochbo shel shulechan, kofel tifchayim mikkan vetifchayim mikkan, vetifchayim revach baemtza, kede shettehe haruach menashshevet bahem.

Abba shaul omer: sham hayu notnin shene beziche levona shel lechem happanim. amru lo: vahare kevar neemar "venatatta al hammaarechet levona zakka"! amar lahem: hare kevar neemar "vealav matte menashshe".

Vearbaa senifin shel zahav hayu sham, mefutztzalin merashehen, shehayu somchin bahem, shenayim leseder ze ushenayim leseder ze, veesrim ushemona kanim kachatzi kane chalul, arbaa asar leseder ze vearbaa asar leseder ze.
Lo siddur kanim velo netilatam docha et hashshabbat, ella nichnas meerev shabbat, veshomto, venotno leorko shel shulchan.
Kol hakkelim shehayu bammikdash, orkan leorko shel bet.

Gemara kol hammenachot yesh bahen maase cheli mibbifnim. shaalu et rabbi: zo minnayin? amar lahem: hare hu omer "vayyomer elay ze hammakom asher yevashshelu sham hakkohanim et hachattat veet haasham asher yofu et hammincha levilti hotzi el hechatzer hachitzona".
Mincha dumeya deasham vechattat, ma asham vechattat teunin keli, af mincha name teuna keli.
Hashshulechan, orko asara.

Amar rabbi yochanan: ledivre haomer tifchayim umechetza kofel – nimtza shulchan mekaddesh chamishsha asar tefachim lemala. ledivre haomer tifchayim kofel – nimtza shulchan mekaddesh shenem asar tefachim lemala.
Vehaikka kanim? kanim shakkoe meshakka lehu.
May tama? mishshum iapposhe lechem. sof sof ka miappash lechem! demagba leh pureta.
Vehaikka hahu pureta? kevan dela have tefach, la chashev leh.
Vehaikka bazichin! begavvevy delechem havo yatvi, ulevahade lechem havo kayymi. vehaikka keranot! keranot legavvevy delechem kayef lehu, velechem alayyhu nach leh!
b: Vehaikka misgarto!
Keman deamar misgarto lematta hayta, uleman deamar misgarto lemala hayta – parkode hava mefarkeda, velechem begavveh deshulchan hava yatev.
Kidtanya, rabbi yose omer: lo haya sham senifin, ella misgarto shel shulchan maamedet et hallechem. amru lo: misgarto lematta hayta.
Amar rabbi yochanan: ledivre haomer misgarto lematta hayta, tavla hammithappechet temea.
Ledivre haomer misgarto lemala hayta, tavla hammithappechet tibbee lach.
Mikkelal deshulchan bar kabbole tumea hu? keli etz heasuy lenachat hu, vechol keli etz heasuy lenachat – en mekabbel tumea.
May tama? dumeya desak baenan – ma sak mittaltel male verekan, af kol mittaltel male verekan.
Shulchan name mittaltel male verekan, kidresh lakish, deamar resh lakish: may dichtiv "al hashshulchan hattahor"? "tahor" – mikkelal deikka tame!
Ella, melammed shemmagbihin oto leole regalim, umarin bo lechem, veomrim lahem: reu chibbatchem lifne hammakom!
Kedivre rabbi yehoshua ben levi, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: nes gadol naasa belechem happanim, silluko kesidduro, shenneemar: "lasum lechem chom beyom hillakcho".

Vetippok li mishshum tzippuy? mi la tenan: hashshulchan vehaddulebaki shennifchatu, o shechippan beshayish, veshiyyer bahen mekom hannachat kosot – temein. rabbi yehuda omer: mekom hannachat chatichot.
Shiyyer – in, lo shiyyer – la.
Vechi tema, kan betzippuy omed, kan betzippuy sheeno omed, veha bea minneh resh lakish merabbi yochanan: betzippuy omed, o betzippuy sheeno omed? beshechippa et

a: Levizbezav, o beshello chippa et levizbezav? veamar leh: la shena tzippuy omed, vela shena tzippuy sheeno omed, la shena chippa et levizbezav, vela shena la chippa levizbezav.

Vechi tema, atze shittim chashivi vela batli – hanicha leresh lakish, deamar: lo shanu ella bichle ekkeslagos habbaim mimmedinat hayyam, aval keli mismas chashivi vela batli – shappir. ella lerabbi yochanan, deamar: kele mismas name batli, may ikka lememar?

Shane shulechan, derachamana karyeh "etz", shenneemar: "hammizbeach etz shalosh ammot gavoah orko shetayim ammot umiktzootav lo veorko vekirotav etz vaydabber elay ze hashshulchan asher lifne Adonai".

Patach bammizbeach vesiyyem bashshulechan? rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar deamri tarvayyhu: bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym – mizbeach mechapper al adam, veachshav sheen bet hammikdash kayyaym – shulechano shel adam mechapper alav.
Arbaa senifin shel zahav hayu sham [vechulei]. mena hane mille? amar rav kattina: amar kera "veasita kearotav vechappotav ukesotav umenakkiyyotav".
"Kearotav" – ellu defusin, "kappotav" – ellu bazichin, "kesotav" – ellu senifin, "umenakkiyyotav" – ellu kanim, "asher yussach bahen" – shemmesakkechin bahen et hallechem.
Motev rava: lo siddur hakkanim velo netilatan dochot et hashshabbat, vei salka datach deorayyta, ammay en dochot et hashshabbat?
Hadar amar rava: lav milleta hi daamari, ditnan, kelal amar rabbi akiva: kol melacha sheefshar lah laasotah meerev shabbat – enah doche et hashshabbat. vehane name efshar dela dache shabbat alayyhu.
Tama may? dela liappash lechem, bechi hay shiura la miappash.

Kidtanya: ketzad? nichnas meerev shabbat veshomtan, umannichan leorko shel shulechan, umotzae shabbat nichnas, magbiah rasheha shel challa umachnis kane tachteha, vechozer umagbiah rasheha shel challa umachnis kane tachteha.
Arbaa challot tzerichot shelosha shelosha kanim, haelyona – enah tzericha ella shenayim, lefi sheen aleha massooy; hattachtona – enah tzericha kol ikkar, lefi shemmunnachat al tohoro shel shulechan.

Tenan hatam: rabbi meir omer: kol ammot shehayu bammikdash benoniyyot, chutz mimmizbach hazzahav, vehakkeren, vehassovev, vehayyesod. rabbi yehuda omer: ammat binyan shishsha tefachim, veshel kelim chamishsha.
Amar rabbi yochanan, ushenehem mikra echad darshu: "veelle middot hammizbeach baammot amma amma vatofach
b: Vechek haamma veamma rochav ugevulah el sefatah saviv zeret haechad veze gav hammizbeach". "chek haamma" – ze yesod, "amma rochav" – ze sovev, "ugevulah el sefatah saviv zeret haechad" – ellu keranot, "ze gav hammizbeach" – ze mizbach hazzahav.
Rabbi meir savar: "zehu" – beamma bat chamishsha, ha kol ammot kelim beamma bat shesh. verabbi yehuda savar: keze yehu kol ammot kelim.
Ka salka datach miyyesod vead sovev beamma bat chamishsha begova. umay "chek haamma veamma rochav"? hachi ka amar: mechek haamma vead rochav beamma bat chamishsha.
Gova hammizbeach kamma have? eser ammot: shet bene chamsha chamsha, vearbee bene shitta shitta.

Mizbeach kamma have? chamshin vearbea. palgeh demizbeach kamma have? esrin veshiva. mikkeranot vead sovev kamma have? esrin vearbea. kamma betzir lefalgeh demizbeach? telata. utenan: chut shel sikra chogro baemtza, kede lehavedil ben damim haelyonim ledamim hattachtonim.

Ella ha detanya gabbe olat haof: haya ole bakkevesh, ufana lassovev, uva lo lekeren deromit [mizrachit], umolek et roshah mimmul orpa, umavdil, umotze et damah al kir hammizbeach, veim asaah lematta meraglav afillu amma achat – keshera.
Ha ka yahev elyona lematta mishshene tefachim!
Ella, "chek haamma" – kenisa, "amma rochav" – kenisa, "gevulah el sefatah saviv" – kenisa.

Mizbeach kamma have leh? shittin. palgeh demizbeach kamma have? telatin. mikkeranot vead sovev kamma have? esrim vearbea. kamma betzir lefalgeh demizbeach? shishsha. utenan: im asaah lematta meraglav afillu amma achat – keshera.
Bemay okemta? bichnisa. umi matzet mokmat lah bichnisa? veha tenan: mizbeach haya sheloshim ushetayim al sheloshim ushetayim, ala amma vechanas amma – zehu yesod, nimtza sheloshim al sheloshim.
Sheloshim ushene tefachim have.
Vetu: ala chamesh, vechanas amma – zehu sovev. nimtza esrim ushemone al esrim ushemone. esrim ushemone (vearba) [vearbaa] tefachim have!
Vechi tema, kevan dela have amma, la chashev leh mekom keranot: amma mizze veamma mizze – nimtza esrim vashesh al esrim vashesh.
Esrin usheva havu! la dak.
Mekom hilluch ragle hakkohanim, amma mizze veamma mizze. nimtza esrim vearba al esrim vearba mekom hammaaracha. esrim vechamesho havay!

Vechi tema hacha name la dak, veha ketiv: "vehaariel shetem esre orech bishtem esre rochav ravua", yachol sheeno ella shetem esre al shetem esre, keshehu omer: "al arbaat revaav", melammed shebbaemtza hu moded shetem esre amma lechol ruach varuach.
Vechi tema: shet minnayyhu meikkara beamma bat chamsha mayyte lehu, im ken – ravvcha la azara.

Ditnan: kol haazara hayta orech mea ushemonim vasheva al rochav mea usheloshim vechamesh, mimmizrach lammaarav mea shemonim vasheva: mekom derisat ragle yisrael – achat esre amma, umekom derisat ragle hakkohanim – achat esre amma, hammizbeach – sheloshim ushetayim, ben ulam velammizbeach – esrim ushetayim amma, hahechol – mea amma, achat esre amma achore bet hakkapporet.
Ella, "chek haamma" – beguveha, "amma rochav" – kenisa, "gevulah el sefatah saviv" –

a: La shena hachi vela shena hachi.
Mizbeach kamma have? chamshin utemanya. palgeh demizbeach kamma have? esrin vetisha. mikkeranot vead sovev kamma havu? esrin utelata.
Kamma betzir lefalgeh demizbeach? shitta, utenan: im asaah lematta meraglav, afillu amma achat – keshera.
Dayka name, dichtiv "chek haamma" veamma rochav", shema minna.
Vechamma amma benonit? amar rabbi yochanan: shishsha tefachim. amar rabbi yose bar avin: af anan name tenena, rabbi meir omer: hashshulchan orko shenem asar verochbo shishsha.

Mikkelal dehavya amma dinfisha minna? in, veha tenan: shete ammot hayu beshushan habbira, achat al keren mizrachit tzefonit veachat al keren mizrachit deromit. sheal keren mizrachit tzefonit yetera al shel moshe chatzi etzba, sheal keren mizrachit deromit hayta yetera aleha chatzi etzba, nimtzet yetera al shel moshe etzba.
Velama amru achat gedola veachat ketanna? kede sheyyehu haummanin notlin bakketanna, umachzirin baggedola, kede shello yavou lide meila.
Vetarte lema li? chada – lechaspa vedahava, vachada – levinyayna.
Tenan hatam: shaar hammizrach, alav shushan habbira tzura. may tama?
Rav chisda verav yitzchak bar avdimi, chad amar: kede sheyyedu mehechan bau, vechad amar: kede shettehe emat malchut alehen.
Amar rabbi yannay: leolam tehe emat malchut alecha, shenneemar: "veyardu chol avadecha elle elay vehishtachavu li lemor", veillu ledideh la kaamar leh.
