Rabbi yochanan amar: mehacha, shenneemar: "veyad Adonai hayta el eliyyahu vayshannes motnav vayyarotz lifne achav ad boacha yizreela".
"Vealehu litrufa" – rav chisda verav yitzchak bar avdimi,
Chad amar lehattir pe shellemala, vechad amar lehattir pe shellematta. ittemar: chizkiyya amar lehattir pe illemim, bar kappara amar lehattir pe akarot.

Tanu rabbanan: illu neemar "velakachta solet veafita otah shetem esre challot vesamta otam shetayim maarachot" velo neemar "shesh", hayiti omer achat shel arba veachat shel shemone, lechach neemar "shesh".
Veillu neemar "shetayim maarachot shesh hammaarachet", velo neemar "shetem esre" – hayiti omer shalosh shel shesh shesh, lechach neemar "shetem esre".

Veillu neemar "shetem esre challot" umaarachot", velo neemar "shetayim" veshesh" – hayiti omer shalosh shel arba arba, lechach neemar "shetayim" veshesh". ha ad shello yeamru shelosha mikraot hallalu lo lamadnu.

Ha ketzad? noten shetayim maarachot shel shesh shesh, veim natan achat shel arba veachat shel shemone – lo yatza, shetayim shel sheva sheva, rabbi omer: roin et haelyona keillu enah. veha baenan "venatatta al"?

Amar leh rav chisda lerav hamenuna, veamri la rav hamenuna lerav chisda: rabbi letameh, deamar "al" besamuch, detanya: rabbi omer "venatatta al hammaarechet levona zakka" – "al" besamuch. atta omer "al" besamuch, o eno ella "al" mammash? keshehu omer "vesakkota al haaron et happarochet", heve omer "al" besamuch.

Kol hakkelim shebbammikdash vechulei. tanu rabbanan: kol hakkelim shebbammikdash orkan leorko shel bayit, chutz mearon sheorko lerochbo shel bayit, vechach haya munnach, vechach hayu baddav munnachin.
May kaamar? hachi kaamar: kach haya munnach, middevaddav kach hayu munnachin.

Uvaddav menalan? detanya: "vayyaarichu habbaddim" – yachol lo hayu nogin bapparochet? talmud lomar "vayyerau". i "vayyerau" – yachol yehu mekarin bapparochet veyotzin? talmud lomar "lo yerau hachutza". ha ketzad?
b: Dochakin uvoltin bapparochet, vedomin kemin shene dadde ishsha, shenneemar: "tzeror hammor dodi li ben shaday yalin".
Umenalan devaddav lefuteya dearon havo yatvi? dilma leorko dearon havo yatvi! amar rabbi yehuda: tere gavre beammeta ufalga la mistaggi lehu.
Umena lan divarbea havo daru lehu? dichtiv "venasu hakkehatim" – tere, "nose hammikdash" – name tere.
Tanu rabbanan: asara shulechanot asa shelomo hammelech, shenneemar: "vayyaas shulchanot asara vayyannach bahechol chamishsha miyyamin vachamishsha missemovl".
Veim tomar: chamishsha mimin happetach, vachamishsha missemol happetach – im ken matzinu sheshshulechan baddarom, vehattora amra: "vehashshulchan titten al tzela tzafon".
Ella, shel moshe baemtza, chamishsha mimino, vachamishsha missemolo.
Tanu rabbanan: eser menorot asa shelomo, shenneemar: "vayyaas et hammenorot hazzahav eser kammishpat vayyitten bahechol chamishsha miyyamin vachamishsha missemovl".
Veim tomar: chamishsha mimin happetach vachamishsha missemol happetach, im ken matzinu menora batztzafon, vehattora amra: "veet hammenora nochach hashshulchan".
Ella, shel moshe baemtza, chamishsha miminah, vachamishsha missemolah.
Tane chada: mechatzi bayit velifnim hayu munnachin, vetane chada: mishshelish habbayit velifnim hayu munnachin.
Vela kashya, mar ka chashev bet kodshe hakkodashim bahade hechol, mar la ka chashev bet kodshe hakkodashim bahade hechol.

Tanu rabbanan: mizrach umaarav hayu munnachin, divre rabbi. rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: tzafon vedarom. may tama derabbi? gamar mimmenora – ma menora mizrach umaarav, af hane name mizrach umaarav.
Umenora gufa menalan? middichtiv bener maaravi "yaaroch oto [aharon vegomer] lifne Adonai" –
Mikkelal dechullehu lav "lifne Adonai", vei salka datach tzafon vedarom, kullehu name "lifne Adonai" ninhu.
Verabbi elazar berabbi shimon may tama? gamar mearon: ma aron tzafon vedarom, af hane name tzafon vedarom. verabbi name ligmar mearon? danin chutz michutz, veen danin chutz mibbifnim.
Verabbi elazar berabbi shimon, ligmar mimmenora? amar lach: menora gufa tzafon vedarom hava mannecha.
Ella hachtiv "yaaroch oto aharon uvanav", dematzded lehu atzdode.
Detanya: "el mul pene hammenora yairu shivat hannerot" – melammed shehayu metzaddedin penehem kelappe ner emtzai. amar rabbi natan: mikkan sheemtzai meshubbach.
Bishlama leman deamar mizrach umaarav – hayeynu dahavo yatyvi asra beesrin, ella leman deamar tzafon vedarom – asra beesrin hechi havo yatvi?
Vetu, kohanim hechi havo ayyli? vetu, matzinu chamishsha shulchanot baddarom! vetu, shulchan demoshe hecha mannach leh?
Velitamaych, leman deamar mizrach umaarav name, shulchan demoshe hecha hava mannach leh?
Ella, mi savrat chad dara hu?! tere dare ninhu!

a: Bishlama leman deamar tzafon vedarom, shappir.
Ella leman deamar mizrach umaarav, mikkede shulchan kamma mashuch min hakkotel? shete ammot umechetza, veamma dideh, ushete ammot umechetza devene bene.
Veamma, ushete ammot umechetza devene bene, veamma dideh – ishtechach dekaachel shulechan palga deammeta bedarom.
Mi savrat shulchan demoshe bahadayyhu hava yatev? la, demaydle leh, umannach leh, umeytatte lehu ledidhu pureta, ketalmid hayyoshev lifne rabbo.
Tanu rabbanan: asara shulchanot asa shelomo, velo hayu mesadderin ella al shel moshe, shenneemar: "veet hashshulchan asher alav lechem happanim zahav".
Eser menorot asa shelomo, velo hayu madlikin ella beshel moshe, shenneemar: "et menorat hazzahav veneroteha levaer baerev".

Rabbi elazar ben shammua omer: al kullam hayu mesadderin, shenneemar: "et hashshulchanot vaalehem lechem happanim", uvechullan hayu madlikin, shenneemar: "et hammenorot venerotehem levaaram kammishpat lifne haddevir zahav sagur".

Rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: lo hayu mesadderin ella al shel moshe, ella ma ani mekayyem "veet hashshulchanot asher alehem lechem happanim zahav"? ellu shelosha shulchanot shehayu bammikdash: shenayim shehayu beulam mibbifnim lefetach habbayit, echad shel kesef veechad shel zahav.
Al shel kesef noten lechem happanim bichnisato, veal shel zahav bitziato, shemmaalin bakkodesh velo moridin. echad shel zahav bifnim, shealav lechem happanim tamid.
Umena lan deen moridin? amar rabbi: deamar kera: "vayyakem moshe et hammishkan vayyitten et adanav vayyasem et kerashav vayyitten et berichav vayyakem et ammudav".

Umenalan demaalin? amar rabbi acha bar yaakov: deamar kera "et machtot hachattaim haelle benafshotam veasu otam rikkue fachim tzippuy lammizbeach ki hikrivum lifne Adonai vayyikdashu veyihyu leot livne yisrael" – battechilla tashmishe mizbeach, veachshav gufo shel mizbeach.

"Asher shibbarta vesamtam baaron" – tane rav yosef: melammed shehalluchot veshivre luchot munnachin baaron. mikkan letalmid chacham sheshshachach talmudo mechamat onso, sheen nohagin bo minhag bizzayon.
(Siman "bittel" "sarach" "veshachach").
Amar resh lakish: peamim
b: Shebbittulah shel tora zehu yissudah, dichtiv: "asher shibbarta", amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe: yishar kochacha sheshshibbarta.
Veamar resh lakish: talmid chacham shessarach, en mevazzin oto befarhesya, shenneemar: "vechashalta hayyom vechashal gam navi immecha layla" – kassehu kallayla.

Veamar resh lakish: kol hameshakkeach davar echad mittalmudo over belav, shenneemar: "hishshamer lecha ushemor nafshecha meod pen tishkach et haddevarim", vechidrabbi avin amar rabbi ila, deamar rabbi avin amar rabbi ila: kol makom shenneemar "hishshamer", "pen", veal" – eno ella lo taase.
Ravina amar: "hishshamer" ufen" shene lavin ninhu. rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: bishlosha lavin, shenneemar: "hishshamer lecha ushemor nafshecha meod pen tishkach et haddevarim".
Yachol afillu mechamat onso? talmud lomar "ufen yasuru millevavcha" – bimsiram millibbo hakkatuv medabber. rabbi dostay berabbi yannay amar: yachol afillu takfa alav mishnato? talmud lomar "rak".

Rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar deamri tarvayyhu: tora nittena bearbaim, uneshama notzra bearbaim. kol hameshammer torato – nishmato mishtammeret, vechol sheeno meshammer et hattora – en nishmato mishtammeret.
Tana deve rabbi yishmael: mashal leadam shemmasar tzippor deror leavdo, amar: kimdumme atta sheim atta meabbedah sheani notel mimmecha issar bedameha? nishmatcha ani notel mimmecha!
Mishna shene shulechanot hayu baulam mibbifnim, al petach habbayit, echad shel shayish veechad shel zahav. al shel shayish notnim lechem happanim bichnisato, veal shel zahav bitziato.
Shemmaalin bakkodesh velo moridin. veechad shel zahav mibbifnim, shealav lechem happanim tamid.
Vearbaa kohanim nichnasin, shenayim beyadam shene sedarim, ushenayim beyadam shene bazichin, vearbaa makdimin lifnehem, shenayim littol shene sedarim, ushenayim littol shene bazichin.

Hammachnisim omdim batztzafon, ufenehem laddarom, vehammotziin omdim baddarom, ufenehem batztzafon. ellu moshchin, veellu mannichin, vetifcho shel ze keneged tifcho shel ze, shenneemar: "lefanay tamid".
Rabbi yose omer: afillu ellu notlin veellu mannichin, af hi hayta "tamid".
Yatzu unetanum al shulchan hazzahav shehaya baulam, hiktiru habbazichin, vehachallot mitchallekot lakkohanim.

Chal yom kippurim lihyot beshabbat, hachallot mitchallekot laerev. chal lihyot beerev shabbat, sair shel yom hakkippurim neechol laerev, vehabbavliyyim ochlin oto keshehu chay, mippene sheddatan yafa.
Gemara tanya: rabbi yose omer, afillu sillek et hayyeshana shacharit vesidder et hachadasha arvit – en bechach kelum, ella ma ani mekayyem "lefanay tamid"? shello yalin shulchan belo lechem.
Amar rabbi amme: middevarav shel rabbi yose nilmod, afillu lo shana adam ella perek echad shacharit uferek echad arvit – kiyyem mitzvat "lo yamush (et) sefer hattora hazze mippicha".

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: afillu lo kara adam ella keriyyat shema shacharit vearvit – kiyyem "lo yamush", vedavar ze asur leomro bifne amme haaretz, verava amar: mitzva leomro bifne amme haaretz.

Shaal ben dama, ben achoto shel rabbi yishmael, et rabbi yishmael: kegon ani, shellamadti kol hattora kullah, mahu lilmod chochmat yevanit? kara alav hammikra hazze: "lo yamush sefer hattora hazze mippicha vehagita bo yomam valayla". tze uvedok shaa sheenah lo min hayyom velo min hallayla, ulemod bah chochmat yevanit.

Ufeliga derabbi shemuel bar nachmani, deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: pasuk ze eno lo chova velo mitzva, ella beracha. raa hakkadosh baruch hu et yehoshua sheddivre tora chavivim alav beyoter, shenneemar: "umesharto yehoshua bin nun naar lo yamish mittoch haohel". amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu: yehoshua, kol kach chavivin alecha divre tora? "lo yamush sefer hattora hazze mippicha".
Tana deve rabbi yishmael: divre tora lo yehu alecha chova, vei atta rashshay liftor atzmecha mehen.

Amar chizkiyya: may dichtiv "veaf hasitcha mippi tzar rachav lo mutzak tachteha"? bo uree shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vedam. middat basar vadam adam mesit et chavero middarche chayyim ledarche mita, vehakkadosh baruch hu mesit et haadam middarche mita ledarche chayyim, shenneemar "veaf hasitcha mippi tzar" miggehinnam, sheppiha tzar, sheashanah tzavur

a: Betochah. veshemma tomar keshem sheppiha tzar kach kullah tzara – talmud lomar "heemik hirchiv".

Veshemma tomar lammelech lo huchena – talmud lomar "gam hi lammelech huchan", veshemma tomar en bah etzim – talmud lomar "meduratah esh veetzim harebe", veshemma tomar ze hu secharah – talmud lomar "venachat shulchancha male dashen".

Chal yom hakkippurim lihyot beshabbat [vechulei]. amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: lo bavliyyim hem, ella alekkesanderiyyim hem, umittoch shessonin et habbavliyyim – korin otam al shem bavliyyim.

Tanya name hachi, rabbi yose omer: lo bavliyyim hem, ella alekkesanderiyyim hem, umittoch shessonin et habbavliyyim – korin otan al shem bavliyyim. amar lo rabbi yehuda: tanuach datecha shehinnachta dati.
Mishna sidder et hallechem bashshabbat, veet habbazichin leachar hashshabbat, vehiktir et habbazichin bashshabbat – pasul, en chayyayvin alehen mishshum piggul, notar, vetame.
Sidder et hallechem veet habbazichin bashshabbat, vehiktir et habbazichin leachar hashshabbat – pesula, veen chayyayvin alehen mishshum piggul, notar, vetame.

Sidder et hallechem veet habbazichin leachar hashshabbat, vehiktir et habbazichin bashshabbat – pesula. ketzad yaase? yannichenna leshabbat habbaa, sheafillu hi al hashshulechan yamim rabbim – en bechach kelum.

Gemara tenan hatam: amar lahem hamemunne: "tzeu ureu im higgia zeman shechita". im higgia, haroe omer: "barkay". mattitya ben shemuel omer: "heir pene kol hammizrach ad shebbechevron", vehu omer: "hen".
Velamma hutzerchu lechach? sheppaam achat ala meor hallevana, vedimmu sheheir mizrach, shachatu et hattamid, vehotziuhu levet hasserefa.
Vehoridu kohen gadol levet hattevila. ze hakkelal haya bammikdash: kol hammesech et raglav taun tevila, vechol hammetil mayim taun kiddush yadayim veraglayim.
Tane avu derabbi avin: lo zo bilvad, ella afillu olat haof shennimleka ballayla, umincha shennikmetza ballayla – tetze levet hasserefa.
Bishlama olat haof – mishshum dela efshar leahdora, ella mincha – efshar demahdar kometz leducheteh vekametz bimama.
Hu tane la, vehu amar la: kele sharet mekaddeshin shello bizmannan.
Metivi: kol hakkarev bayyom – kadosh bayyom, ballayla – kadosh ballayla, ben bayyom uven ballayla – kadosh ben bayyom uven ballayla.
Kol hakkarev bayyom – kadosh bayyom; "bayyom" – in, "ballayla" – la; eno kadosh likrav, aval kadosh lippasel.

Motev rabbi zera: sidder et hallechem veet habbazichin achar shabbat, vehiktir et habbazichin bashshabbat – pesula. ketzad yaase? yannichenna leshabbat habbaa, sheafillu hi al hashshulchan yamim rabbim en bechach kelum.
Vei salka datach kele sharet mekaddeshin shello bizmannan (lippasel) – likdosh velippesul.
Amar rabba: man deka motev – shappir ka motev, avu derabbi avin name matnita kaamar. kasavar: layla en mechussar zeman, ha yamim mechussarin zeman.
Sof sof,
b: Ki mate lelya deve shimshe likdosh velippesol? amar rava: beshekkadam vesillek.
Mar zutera, veittema rav ashe, amar: afillu tema beshello kadam vesillek, kevan desiddero shello kemitzvato – naasa kemi shessiddero hakkof.

Mishna shete hallechem neechalot en pachot mishshenayim, velo yoter al shelosha. ketzad? neefot meerev yom tov – neechalot beyom tov lishnayim. chal yom tov lihyot achar hashshabbat – neechalot lishlosha.
Lechem happanim neechol en pachot mittisha, velo yoter al achad asar. ketzad? neefe meerev shabbat – veneechol beshabbat letisha. chal yom tov lihyot erev shabbat – neechol laasara.

Shene yamim [tovim] shel rosh hashshana – neechol leachad asar. veeno doche lo et hashshabbat velo et yom tov. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mishshum rabbi shimon ben hassegan: doche et yom tov, veeno doche et yom tzom.
Gemara amar ravina: ledivre haomer nedarim unedavot en kerevin beyom tov, la tema middeorayyta michza chazu, verabbanan hu digzaru shello yeshahe, ella middeorayyta name la chazu.
Deha shete hallechem dechovat hayyom hu, velekka lememar shemma yeshahe, vekatane eno doche lo et hashshabbat velo et yom tov.
Hadaran alach shete hallechem.
Mishna hammenachot vehannesachim shennitmeu, ad shello kadshu bichli – yesh lahem pidyon; mishshekkadshu bichli – en lahem pidyon.
Haofot vehaetzim vehallevona uchele sharet, mishshennitmeu – en lahen pidyon, shello neemar pidyon ella bivhema.
Gemara amar shemuel: vaafillu hen tehorin nifdin. may tama? kamma dela kadshi bichli – kedushshat damim ninhu, ukedushshat damim nifdin.
Veha nitmeu tenan? hu haddin deaf al gav delo nitmeu, veayyeyde deka bae mitne sefa mishshekkadshu bichli en lahen pidyon, daafillu nitmeu name la, tena name resha shennitmeu ad shello kadshu bichli.
Peshita, kedushshat hagguf ninhu!

Itzterich, salka datach amena: hoil uvaal mum ikkeri "tame", tame name kevaal mum dame, veaf al gav dekadosh kedushshat hagguf, ki nafel beh mum – mipperik, hane name lipperuk. kamashma lan, delav ki hay "tame" karyeh rachamana levaal mum,

a: Demikkele sharet la ashkechan demipperik.
Uvaal mum hecha ikkeri "tame"? detanya: "veim kol behema temea asher lo yakrivu mimmenna korban laAdonai" – bevaale mumin shennifdin hakkatuv medabber.

Atta omer bevaale mumin shennifdu, o eno ella bivhema temea mammash? keshehu omer "veim babbehema hattemea ufada veerkecha", hare behema temea amura. ha ma ani mekayyem "veim kol behema temea"? bevaale mumin shennifdu hakkatuv medabber.
Yachol yippadu al mum over? talmud lomar "asher lo yakrivu mimmenna korban laAdonai" – mi sheenah kereva laAdonai kol ikkar, yatzta zo sheenah kereva hayyom ukereva lemachar.

Motev rav huna bar manoach: haofot vehaetzim vehallevona uchele sharet shennitmeu, en lahen pidyon, shello neemar pidyon ella bivhema. bishlama ofot – kedushshat hagguf ninhu, velo neemar ella bivhema.
Ella etzim ulevona uchele sharet – lipparku? ella lav mishshum dithorin bealma en nifdin.
Vehane name, af al gav denitmeu – kithorim damu, deetzim ulevona lav bene ashvoye uchela ninhu, ella chibbat hakkodesh mashve lehu uchela.
Deetzim, kamma dela meshappe lehu ligzirin – la mittachsheri. levona name, kamma dela kaydsha bichli sharet – la mittachshera. kele sharet name, hoil veit lehu tohora bemikve.
La, leolam ema lach: tehorin bealma nifdin, vehane – mishshum dela shechichi hu.
Bishlama levona uchele sharet – la shechichi, ella etzim – mishkach shechichi! etzim name, kevan deamar mar: kol etz shennimtza bo tolaat pasul legabbe mizbeach, hilkach la shechichi.

Amar rav pappa: i shemia leh lishmuel ha detanya, hammatpis temimim levedek habbayit – en podin otan ella lammizbeach, shekkol harauy lammizbeach eno yotze mide mizbeach leolam, veaf al gav dikdushshat damim ninhu – en nifdin hoil utehorim hem, hava hadar beh.
Vela hi, shemia leh vela hadar beh. lav amrat hatam: kevan dela shechichi – la mipparki.
Hacha name, kevan dishchichi mumin defasli bivhema, daafillu bedukkin shebbaayin name pasli, hilkach la shechichi.
Rav kahana amar: temein – nifdin, tehorin – en nifdin. vechen amar rabbi oshaya: temein – nifdin, tehorin – en nifdin. ikka deamri amar rabbi oshaya: afillu tehorin – nifdin.
Rabbi elazar omer: kullan temein – nifdin, tehorin – en nifdin, chutz measirit haefa shel minchat chote.
Shehare amra tora: "mechattato" "al chattato".
Amar rabbi oshaya: shamati piggel bemincha lerabbi shimon eno metamme tumeat ochalin, ditnan: haorla vechile hakkerem
b: Veshor hanniskal veegla arufa vetzippore metzora ufeter chamor uvasar bechalav kullam mittammein tumeat ochalin.
Rabbi shimon omer: kullan en mittammein tumeat ochalin, umode rabbi shimon bevasar bechalav shemmetamme tumeat ochalin, hoil vehayta lo sheat hakkosher.

Veamar rav assi, amar rabbi yochanan: may tama derabbi shimon? "mikkol haochel asher yeachel" – ochel sheatta yachol lehaachilo laacherim karuy ochel, ochel shei atta yachol lehaachilo laacherim eno karuy ochel.
Veha piggel bemincha name, ochel shei atta yachol lehaachilo laacherim hu.
I hachi, basar bechalav name tippok leh, deochel sheatta yachol lehaachilo laacherim hu.

Detanya, rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon: basar bechalav asur baachila umuttar bahanaa, shenneemar "ki am kadosh atta laAdonai elohecha lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo", ulehallan hu omer "veanshe kodesh tihyun li uvasar bassade terefa lo tochelu", ma lehallan asur baachila umuttar bahanaa, af kan asur baachila umuttar bahanaa.
Chada veod kaamar: chada, deochel sheatta yachol lehaachilo laacherim hu, veod, ledideh name hayta lo sheat hakkosher.
Metivi: rabbi shimon omer, yesh notar shehu metamme tumeat ochalin, veyesh notar sheeno metamme tumeat ochalin.
Ketzad? lan lifne zerika – eno metamme tumeat ochalin, leachar zerika – metamme tumeat ochalin.
(Veha) ufiggul, ben bekodshe kadashim ben bekadashim kallim – eno metamme tumeat ochalin. piggel bemincha – metamme tumeat ochalin.
La kashya, kan – shehayta lah sheat hakkosher, kan – shello hayta lah sheat hakkosher.
Hechi dame delo hayta lah sheat hakkosher? deakdeshinhu bimchubbar.
Velifrekinhu! hanicha lehach lishshana deamar rabbi oshaya: temein – nifdin, tehorin – en nifdin, shappir.
Ella lehach lishshana deamar, afillu tehorin nifdin, lifrekinhu.
Hasheta miha la parek.
Vechevan dei bae parek leh, shaminan leh lerabbi shimon deamar: kol haomed lifdot – kefaduy dame.
Detanya, rabbi shimon omer: para metammea tumeat ochalin, hoil vehayta lah sheat hakkosher. veamar resh lakish: omer haya rabbi shimon, para nifdet al gav maarachtah.
Hachi hasheta? bishlama para, omedet lifdot hi, sheim matza acheret naa hemenna – mitzva lifdotah. ella hane menachot, mitzva lifdotan?!
Veha lan lifne zerika, demitzva lemizrekeh, vei bae zarak, vekatane deen mittamme tumeat ochalin!
Hacha bemay askinan – shello hayta shehut bayyom lemizrekeh.
Aval hayta lo shehut beyom, may? metamme tumeat ochalin.
Addetane lan leachar zerika metamme tumeat ochalin – liflog bedida: bamme devarim amurim? shello hayta lo shehut beyom, aval hayta lo shehut bayyom – metamme tumeat ochalin!
Hachi name kaamar: lan, kodem sheyyerae lizrika – eno metamme tumeat ochalin, leachar sheyyerae lizrika – metamme tumeat ochalin.
